paper.title: E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable paramet

summary.core_problem: VLM 推理时视觉 token 数量过多导致延迟与显存开销大，如何在不训练/不微调的前提下做稳健 token pruning。
summary.importance: 贡献点在推理侧的无训练剪枝策略；对预训练本身不直接，但对“视觉 tokenizer 粒度/冗余”与推理预算分配有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段证据融合：阶段1把每个 attention head 视为独立证据源，基于证据清晰度与 head 间一致性估计可靠性，并把 token 表示为 important/unimportant/uncertain 三态；阶段2用 Dempster–Shafer 证据理论量化跨层冲突并融合多层证据；再加空间新颖性约束避免过度丢弃局部新信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM、剪枝比例-精度曲线、与 attention-score pruning 等基线的定量差距；宣称无需辅助模型/参数/微调，主要收益是降低延迟与显存同时保持性能。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs use hundreds of visual tokens, causing high latency and memory; how to prune tokens robustly without training or fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Inference-time, training-free pruning; not a pretraining contribution, but relevant to understanding visual-token redundancy and budget allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Progressive two-stage evidence fusion: (1) treat each attention head as an evidence source, estimate head reliability via evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and assign each token a 3-state belief (important/unimportant/uncertain); (2) use Dempster–Shafer theory to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse evidence across layers; add a spatial novelty constraint to preserve locally novel regions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks concrete model names, pruning-vs-accuracy curves, and strong baselines; claims latency/memory reduction while maintaining performance, with zero extra parameters and no fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 当作“无训练 VLM token 剪枝”的一个可复现思路看：只需看它的剪枝率-精度曲线和消融；证据理论包装可能大于实质。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a training-free VLM token pruning recipe—check pruning-rate vs accuracy and ablations; the Dempster–Shafer framing may be more packaging than substance.

paper.title: Lexical Perturbations Disrupt LLM Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Attention Diversion
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, but their robustness to realistic lexical corruption remains poorly understood. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Di

summary.core_problem: 研究真实词汇级扰动为何会显著破坏 LLM 推理，尤其是字符噪声与子词切分碎片化带来的注意力偏移机制。
summary.importance: 这类工作不直接推进预训练 recipe，但对 tokenizer 设计、鲁棒性训练和推理失效诊断有参考价值。贡献主要是机制分析：把性能下降归因到 token fragmentation 引发的 attention diversion，而不是简单的输入变长。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在多种 lexical corruption 条件下评测开源与 frontier instruction-tuned 模型，包括键盘噪声、字符交换和 filler insertion。随后通过注意力分析、长度匹配对照和因子化干预，分离 prompt 变长、token 内容损坏与注意力重分配三种因素，提出 Attention Diversion 解释。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个开源指令模型和若干 frontier 模型，在 4 个推理 benchmark 上测试。结论是字符级扰动会显著降低多步推理准确率，而 filler insertion 影响较小；长度匹配对照显示主要问题不是序列变长，而是 subword fragmentation；中后层注意力对碎片 token 分配异常偏高。摘要未给出具体提升或模型规模，因此更适合作为现象论文阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why realistic lexical perturbations strongly disrupt LLM reasoning, focusing on how character noise and subword fragmentation divert attention.
summary_en.importance: It does not directly advance pretraining recipes, but it is useful for tokenizer design, robustness training, and failure diagnosis. The main contribution is mechanistic: performance loss is attributed to attention diversion caused by token fragmentation rather than mere prompt length increase.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate open-weight and frontier instruction-tuned models under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. They then use attention analysis, length-matched controls, and factorial interventions to separate the effects of sequence length, corrupted token content, and attention redistribution, proposing the Attention Diversion account.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four open-weight instruction-tuned models plus frontier models on four reasoning benchmarks. Character-level perturbations substantially hurt multi-step reasoning, while filler insertion has limited effect. Length-matched controls suggest the main culprit is subword fragmentation rather than longer inputs, and middle-to-late layers over-attend to fragmented tokens. The abstract does not provide exact model sizes or effect magnitudes, so this is best treated as a phenomenon paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但 tokenizer/鲁棒性方向的人该看；只读长度匹配对照和中后层 attention 分析，若实验干净，说明很多“噪声鲁棒性差”其实是分词器债务。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but worth a look if you care about tokenization or robustness; read the length-matched controls and mid/late-layer attention analysis first.

paper.title: The Emergence of Relevance Through Axiomatic Attention Patterns During LoRA Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: LoRA fine-tuning is standard for adapting LLMs to reranking, but it remains unclear where in the network task-specific relevance behavior is learned and what attention-level changes accompany that learning. Through ablation and attention experiments, we identify where LoRA attention updates to RankLLaMA improve performance and whether those gains coincide with interpretable relevance-oriented attention patterns such as lexical matching, rarity sensitivity, and query-document interaction. We find

summary.core_problem: 分析 LoRA 微调 LLM reranker 时，任务相关的 relevance 行为在网络哪些层、哪些 attention 更新中形成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。论文不提出新的基座训练方法，但给出 LoRA attention 更新的层位置效应，以及这些更新是否对应可解释的信息检索 attention pattern；对理解参数高效微调如何局部改变模型有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 以 RankLLaMA reranking 为对象，做 LoRA attention/MLP 的层级消融，并检测 attention 是否更符合 IR 公理化模式，例如 lexical matching、rarity sensitivity、query-document interaction。核心发现是，在 MLP 全层 LoRA 已微调的条件下，只在中间层一小段 attention 加 LoRA 就能恢复全 attention LoRA 超过一半的性能收益；移除该区域的 attention 微调损失更大。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、数据集和数值表。实验包含 RankLLaMA 上的 attention/MLP LoRA ablation，以及 fine-tuning 前后 attention pattern 与 reranking performance 的对应关系分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies where task-specific relevance behavior emerges during LoRA fine-tuning of LLM rerankers and what attention-level changes accompany it.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis rather than a base-model training contribution. Its value is in localizing which attention layers matter for PEFT adaptation and connecting those layers to interpretable IR-style relevance patterns.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using RankLLaMA as the target reranker, the authors perform layer-wise ablations of LoRA updates in attention and MLP modules. They then inspect whether fine-tuning increases attention patterns aligned with axiomatic IR signals such as lexical matching, rarity sensitivity, and query-document interaction. A key finding is that, given LoRA-tuned MLPs across the network, attention LoRA restricted to a compact mid-network region recovers over half of the gains from applying LoRA to all attention layers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, datasets, or exact metric improvements. The experiments include RankLLaMA ablations and attention-pattern analyses before and after LoRA fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 窄在 reranking，但中层 attention LoRA 的定位结果可作 PEFT 机制备查；看 ablation 图即可。
recommendation.en: Narrowly about reranking, but the mid-layer attention LoRA localization is useful PEFT evidence; the ablation figures are enough.

paper.title: Which Question Is Your Attention Metric Answering? Attention Rows as Compositional Data
paper.abstract: Each row of a transformer's attention matrix is a probability distribution over tokens, and in trained models most of that probability lands on a single \emph{sink} token, usually the first. Standard tools for comparing attention rows (cosine similarity, Jensen--Shannon divergence, Shannon entropy) therefore hinge on a choice papers rarely report: keep the sink, or drop it and renormalize. This choice can reverse conclusions. On ten pretrained models from five families, 17--47% of verdicts about

summary.core_problem: Transformer注意力行（对token的分布）在存在attention sink时，常用相似度/熵度量到底在回答哪个问题、会不会被“是否保留sink”这一实现细节误导。
summary.importance: 机制分析/方法学纠偏：指出大量attention分析结论对“保留sink vs 去掉并重归一化”的约定高度敏感，可能导致头聚类等结构性结论是artifact；给出更合适的度量分解方式。
summary.technical_approach: 把attention row视为compositional data：用Aitchison distance将差异正交分解为sink项与content项；给出entropy的精确分解恒等式，并建议分别报告“sink占比”和“内容分布形状”的差异，而不是混成一个数。
summary.experiments: 在10个预训练模型（5个家族）上做度量敏感性检验：关于“两个head谁更相似”的判定有17–47%会因是否去掉sink而翻转；标准BERT head-clustering流程中最显著结构可由该约定诱发（artifact）。
summary.authors_note: Yale University Human Nature Lab；University of Pennsylvania / Wharton Statistics and Data Science（Regina Ruane）

summary_en.core_problem: When attention sinks dominate attention rows, what question do common attention metrics actually answer, and how sensitive are conclusions to the convention of keeping vs dropping the sink token?
summary_en.importance: Methodological correction for interpretability: many attention-based conclusions (e.g., head similarity, clustering structure) can be artifacts of an unreported convention; proposes metrics that separate sink mass from content allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treat each attention row as compositional data. Use Aitchison distance to orthogonally decompose differences into a sink term and a content term; provide an exact identity that decomposes entropy similarly, advocating separate reporting of sink share vs content-shape differences.
summary_en.experiments: Across 10 pretrained models from 5 families, 17–47% of pairwise “which head is more similar” verdicts flip depending on whether the sink is kept or dropped+renormalized; the dominant structure in a standard BERT head-clustering pipeline is shown to be an artifact of this choice.
summary_en.authors_note: Yale University Human Nature Lab; University of Pennsylvania / Wharton Statistics and Data Science (Regina Ruane).

recommendation.zh: 把attention row当成成分数据来处理是个干净的纠偏：以后做head相似度/聚类先看它的分解，不然结论可能只是“sink处理约定”的副产物。
recommendation.en: A clean methodological fix: decompose sink mass vs content allocation before doing head similarity/clustering, or you may be measuring your sink-handling convention.

institutions: Affiliation:Department of Statistics and Data Science, The Wharton School

paper.title: Conflict and Congruency Effects in Large Language Models: In-Weight and In-Context Competition in a Verbal Conflict Task
paper.abstract: Congruency effects, observed in conflict tasks such as Stroop and flanker tasks, have been investigated for nearly a century in psychology and neuroscience, but their mechanistic basis is not fully understood. We introduce a verbal-only LLM conflict task in which a prompt stem elicits a default same-color completion and an explicit rule either agrees with (congruent condition) or conflicts with (incongruent condition) the completion. Gemma-2-2B and six Pythia models ranging from 410M to 12B para

summary.core_problem: 心理学冲突任务（如Stroop任务）中的一致性效应已有近百年研究历史，但其底层机制尚未完全明确；现有双过程理论、并行分布处理（PDP）模型要么缺乏具体算法级的机制解释，要么人为硬编码了响应通路和控制结构，无法回答通用预训练的模型是否会自发涌现出类似的自动-控制双通路；同时已有研究观测到LLM中存在一致性效应，但尚未用机制可解释性工具拆解其内部加工通路。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的具体启发包括两点：一是验证了仅通过next-token自监督预训练，Transformer架构就能自发涌现出两种独立的响应通路（权重内存储的默认响应、上下文即时解析的规则驱动响应）及其竞争机制，为理解预训练如何催生高级认知控制能力提供了实证依据；二是定位了两种控制来源对应的神经通路差异，为后续通过调整预训练目标、数据配比来优化模型的指令遵循能力、抗干扰能力提供了可解释性层面的抓手。
summary.technical_approach: 设计纯语言形式的LLM冲突任务：提示词词干会触发模型产生默认的同色补全倾向，同时给出的显式规则分为与默认倾向一致（一致条件）和冲突（不一致条件）两种。选取Gemma-2-2B和6个参数量从410M到12B的Pythia模型作为测试对象，采用因果归因分析、注意力分析、注意力消融三种机制可解释性工具，定位LLM中处理默认响应和规则控制响应的不同加工通路。
summary.experiments: 7个测试模型中有6个表现出显著的一致性效应（冲突条件下性能明显下降），所有模型都存在强烈的默认同色补全倾向。通过可解释性方法识别出两条功能独立的加工通路：一条是依赖短程注意力、调用权重内预训练语义知识的默认响应通路，另一条是依赖长程注意力、负责解析和执行上下文显式规则的控制通路。注意力消融实验验证了两条通路的因果作用：关闭对应通路会选择性损害对应条件下的模型性能，不会影响另一条件的表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先阅读引言中对现有心理学模型局限性的梳理，重点关注第3章的纯语言冲突任务设计逻辑，再阅读第4-5章的通路定位结果与消融验证实验。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Congruency effects in psychological conflict tasks (e.g., the Stroop task) have been studied for nearly a century, but their underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Existing dual-process theories and parallel distributed processing (PDP) models either lack concrete algorithmic mechanistic explanations, or artificially hard-code response pathways and control structures, so they cannot answer whether general-purpose pretrained models spontaneously emerge similar automatic-controlled dual pathways. While congruency effects have been observed in LLMs in prior work, their internal processing pathways have not been dissected with mechanistic interpretability tools.
summary_en.importance: This work brings two concrete implications for pretraining research. First, it verifies that Transformer architectures trained only with next-token self-supervised learning can spontaneously emerge two independent response pathways (default responses stored in weights, rule-driven responses parsed online from context) and their competition mechanism, providing empirical evidence for how pretraining produces high-level cognitive control capabilities. Second, it locates the neural pathway differences corresponding to the two control sources, offering interpretability-level handles for optimizing LLM instruction following and interference resistance by adjusting pretraining objectives or data mixtures.
summary_en.technical_approach: A verbal-only LLM conflict task is designed: a prompt stem elicits a default same-color completion tendency in models, while an explicit rule provided in the prompt is either congruent (consistent with the default tendency) or incongruent (conflicting with it). Gemma-2-2B and six Pythia models with parameters ranging from 410M to 12B are selected as test subjects. Three mechanistic interpretability tools — causal attribution analysis, attention analysis, and attention ablation — are adopted to locate distinct processing pathways for default responses and rule-controlled responses in LLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Six of the seven tested models show significant congruency effects (notable performance degradation under incongruent conditions), and all models exhibit strong default same-color completion tendencies. Two functionally independent processing pathways are identified via interpretability methods: a default response pathway that relies on short-range attention and invokes in-weight pretrained semantic knowledge, and a control pathway that relies on long-range attention and is responsible for parsing and executing explicit in-context rules. Attention ablation experiments validate the causal role of both pathways: disabling a target pathway selectively impairs model performance under the corresponding condition, without affecting performance under the other condition.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: First read the Introduction for the review of limitations in existing psychological models, focus on Section 3 for the design logic of the verbal-only conflict task, then read Sections 4-5 for pathway localization results and ablation validation experiments. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 双通路机制的识别方法可迁移到预训练训练动态分析，重点看§4因果归因与注意力消融实验设计。
recommendation.en: The dual-pathway identification methodology is transferable to pretraining training dynamic analysis; focus on §4 causal attribution and attention ablation experimental design.

paper.title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which

summary.core_problem: 论文想回答一个较窄但有用的问题：LLM 在把数值序列当文本做 in-context learning 时，内部表示是否真的按序列动力学复杂度组织，而不只是最终预测误差看起来有差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。它把注意力矩阵看成 token 图，把 hidden states 看成图上信号，用图谱诊断来分析数值 ICL。这个视角适合补足纯 output-level evaluation 的不足：两个序列族的外推误差可能接近，但内部表示的连通性、频谱能量和谱熵已经不同。对基座模型研究来说，价值在于提供了一套可复用的表征诊断工具，尤其适合研究长上下文中模型如何组织非自然语言结构，例如时间序列、程序 trace、表格和离散化后的多模态 token。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把每一层、每个 attention head 的 post-softmax attention 矩阵视为一个加权图，token hidden states 是定义在图节点上的信号。论文使用三个图谱指标：normalized Fiedler value 衡量 attention 图的全局连通性；high-frequency energy ratio 衡量 hidden-state 信号在图上的粗糙程度；spectral entropy 衡量信号频谱支撑的分散程度。实验输入包括 10 类一维序列族：常数序列、不同 r 参数下的 logistic map 周期轨道和混沌轨道，以及 Lorenz 系统 x 分量。logistic map 被用作主控对象，因为它在相同递推形式下可以沿 period-doubling 路径从低周期过渡到混沌。数值序列被线性缩放到 50 到 950，量化为三位整数，并用逗号分隔；这样三位数字和逗号在常见 tokenizer 中通常是单 token，可以保持数值状态与 token 的一一对应，避免数字被拆分后污染图分析。
summary.experiments: 主要实验每个序列族采样 20 条轨迹，并比较不同 context length 下的层内表示。结论是：context length 增加后，内部表示更清楚地按输入动力学复杂度排序；周期更长、混沌程度更高的序列，在图谱指标上与低复杂度序列分离更明显。论文还指出，某些输入族在最终外推误差上很接近，但 graph-spectral diagnostics 可以区分它们，说明输出误差不是观察数值 ICL 的唯一有效信号。附录还扩展到带 distribution shift、平滑周期变化和随机演化的结构化数值序列，用来检查现象是否只依赖 logistic map 设置。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Methods 中的数值序列序列化设计和三个谱指标定义；这部分决定了分析是否可信。图 1 可以帮助理解 attention graph + hidden-state signal 的建模方式。主结果图和附录中关于 extrapolation error 聚集但表征指标分离的图值得看，因为它们说明这种诊断相对常规误差指标提供了什么额外信息。若关注 tokenizer 和数值表示，建议细看三位整数、逗号分隔、全轨迹先量化再截断这些实现选择；这些细节比图谱术语更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs organize numerical sequence information internally according to dynamical complexity during in-context learning, rather than only showing differences in final prediction error.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic. It proposes a representation-level lens for numerical ICL: attention matrices define token graphs, and hidden states define graph signals. This helps expose structure that output error alone can miss. The same type of analysis could be useful for long-context pretraining studies where the input is structured but serialized as tokens, such as time series, tables, program traces, or discretized multimodal streams.
summary_en.technical_approach: At each transformer layer and attention head, the post-softmax attention matrix is treated as a weighted graph over tokens. Hidden states are treated as node signals on that graph. The paper applies three graph-spectral diagnostics: normalized Fiedler value for global connectivity, high-frequency energy ratio for signal roughness, and spectral entropy for the breadth of spectral support. The controlled input suite contains constant sequences, logistic-map trajectories with increasing periods and chaotic regimes, and the x-component of the Lorenz system. The logistic map is the main controlled family because changing the parameter r moves the dynamics from low-period behavior through period doubling to chaos while preserving the recurrence form. Numerical values are rescaled to 50-950, rounded to zero-padded three-digit integers, and separated by commas, so that numeric values and separators align cleanly with tokens under common tokenizers.
summary_en.experiments: The main suite uses 10 sequence families with 20 trajectory realizations per family. The reported pattern is that longer contexts make internal representations more clearly ordered by input dynamical complexity. Periodic sequences with longer periods and chaotic sequences become more separable from low-complexity inputs in the graph-spectral diagnostics. The paper also notes cases where output extrapolation errors remain tightly clustered while representation-level diagnostics separate the input families. Additional appendix experiments consider structured numerical sequences with distribution shifts, smooth periodic variation, and stochastic evolution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20-30 minutes. Focus on the serialization design and the definitions of the three spectral diagnostics, since these choices determine the validity of the analysis. Figure 1 is useful for the attention-graph and graph-signal framing. The main result figures and the appendix comparison against extrapolation error are the most relevant parts. Readers interested in tokenizer effects should pay attention to the three-digit integer format, comma tokens, and the decision to quantize the full trajectory before truncation.

recommendation.zh: ICL 机制分析的新视角，图谱诊断方法可借鉴；重点看图谱指标和可视化部分，结论偏描述性。
recommendation.en: A new perspective on ICL mechanism analysis; the graph-spectral diagnostic methodology is worth borrowing. Focus on spectral metrics and visualizations; conclusions are mostly descriptive.

paper.title: How Do LLMs Read Bug Reports? An Empirical Study of Attention in LLMs for Automated Program Repair
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based Automated Program Repair systems are advancing rapidly, yet their performance remains inconsistent. Even when provided with the same contextual information, an LLM may generate a correct patch for one bug but fail on another closely related bug. Why this happens remains poorly understood, and it is unclear how LLMs prioritize the diverse information in bug reports and whether model attention affects repair success. In this paper, we present the first empirical st

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 在自动程序修复中如何读取 bug report，以及不同注意力分布是否与修复成功相关。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是经验性机制分析，聚焦代码修复场景下的 attention pattern。它有助于理解 SWE 类任务中模型如何利用自然语言 bug 描述，但不直接改变预训练 recipe 或代码模型训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文对真实 Python 和 Java bug 的 LLM 修复过程做 attention 分析，按 bug report 的不同 section 统计注意力分布，并比较成功修复与失败修复之间的差异。研究问题包括 section-level attention、section 内部 attention，以及这些 pattern 与人工认为有信息量内容之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 319 个真实 bug，来源包括 SWE-bench Verified 和 Multi-SWE-bench。摘要未说明具体使用哪些 LLM、是否分析开源模型注意力、是否有 causal intervention，也未给出成功率或注意力差异的定量结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LLMs attend to bug reports during automated program repair, and whether attention patterns differ between successful and failed repairs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical mechanistic analysis in a code-repair setting. It may help interpret how models use natural-language bug reports in SWE-style tasks, but it does not directly change pretraining recipes or code-model training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze attention over real Python and Java bugs, grouping bug-report content into sections and comparing attention allocation across successful and unsuccessful repairs. The study asks how attention is distributed across sections, how within-section patterns differ by outcome, and how those patterns relate to information-bearing parts of the report.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 319 real-world bugs from SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench. The provided abstract does not specify the exact LLMs, whether attention comes from open-weight models, whether causal interventions are performed, or the quantitative effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RQ 设置和成功/失败 attention 对比；APR 解释性有用，但不要外推成 base model 机制。
recommendation.en: Skim the RQ setup and success-vs-failure attention comparisons; useful for APR interpretability, weak evidence for base-model mechanisms.

paper.title: Mechanistic Attention Guidance for Agent Memory Refinement
paper.abstract: Existing self-evolving memory systems mainly improve agent memory based on textual outputs, such as task trajectories and reflections. However, this text-based paradigm rarely incorporates internal mechanistic signals, leaving how retrieved memory is actually utilized during task execution underexplored. This limitation can lead to unreliable error attribution and hallucinated memory modifications. In this work, we show that retrieval-head attention provides a mechanistic signal for revealing se

summary.core_problem: 解决 self-evolving agent memory 只根据文本轨迹和反思改写记忆，难以判断执行时实际使用了哪些记忆的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 记忆系统方法，并带有机制信号使用。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但它尝试把 attention 中的 retrieval-head 信号用于外部记忆调优，适合作为“内部激活信号能否指导系统级更新”的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 论文观察 retrieval-head attention 可以作为 segment-level memory utilization 的信号。方法将不同记忆片段和决策步骤上的 attention 聚合成 context utilization matrix，再根据重复出现的使用模式选择记忆更新策略。AGMR 针对失败执行修正或增强相关记忆，也可以简化无用记忆。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体任务、模型规模、baseline 名称或量化提升，只说明 AGMR 用 attention 暴露的利用模式来指导 segment-level memory updates，并声称可减少错误归因和 hallucinated memory modifications。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses self-evolving agent memory systems that revise memory from textual trajectories and reflections without knowing which memory segments were actually used during execution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory method with a mechanistic signal. It is only indirectly relevant to pretraining, but it is a useful case study for using internal attention patterns to drive system-level memory updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper treats retrieval-head attention as a signal of segment-level memory utilization. It aggregates attention over memory segments and decision steps into a context utilization matrix, then uses recurring utilization patterns to select targeted memory refinement actions. AGMR updates failed-execution memories by correcting, enriching, or simplifying segments.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide task details, model sizes, baseline names, or numerical gains. It states that AGMR uses attention-derived utilization patterns to guide segment-level memory updates and reduce unreliable attribution or hallucinated memory modifications.

recommendation.zh: Agent 记忆不是主线；只看 retrieval-head attention 到 utilization matrix 的构造，别把效果当机制证据。
recommendation.en: Agent memory is not the main pretraining thread; inspect the retrieval-head-to-utilization-matrix construction, but do not treat performance as mechanistic proof.

paper.title: Ask Twice, Look Twice: Prompt Echoing Resolves the Question-First Paradox in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Where should the question go in a vision-language model (VLM) prompt: before the image or after it? Intuition says before: knowing what is asked should tell the model where to look. Yet across visual question answering benchmarks, question-first prompting consistently underperforms the image-first ordering recommended for frontier VLMs, a phenomenon we term the question-first paradox. We trace the paradox to a conflict between two stages of VLM computation. Logit-lens and attention probes show t

summary.core_problem: 解释 VLM 中“问题放在图像前反而更差”的 prompt 顺序悖论，并寻找无需训练的修正方式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理机制分析加轻量 prompt 方法。它把 prompt 顺序问题拆成两个阶段：问题在图像前确实能引导视觉表征，但答案 token 在生成时更难读取被大量图像 token 隔开的早期问题。这对多模态预训练中的序列布局、图文 interleaving 和 answer-token conditioning 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 logit lens、attention probe 和 causal attention knockout 分析 VLM 内部计算。核心诊断是：question-first 改善感知阶段的 patch 表征对齐，但破坏答案阶段对问题文本的访问。由此提出 prompt echoing，即把问题在图像前后各放一次，同时保留视觉引导和答案条件。
summary.experiments: 实验横跨多个 VQA benchmark，比较 question-first、image-first 和 prompt echoing。摘要说明 question-first 在 VQA 上稳定弱于 image-first，attention knockout 验证答案 token 只有在问题位于图像之后时才有效读取问题；具体模型列表和提升数字未在摘要中给出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University；Deva Ramanan 是知名计算机视觉研究者，长期研究视觉识别、检测和视觉基础模型相关问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why placing the question before the image can hurt VLM performance, despite the intuition that it should guide visual perception.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic VLM analysis plus a training-free prompt fix. It separates perceptual steering from answer-token conditioning: a question before the image can shape image representations, but the final answer token may fail to attend back to that question after hundreds of visual tokens. This is relevant for multimodal sequence layout and native VLM pretraining design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use logit-lens analysis, attention probes, and causal attention knockout. Their diagnosis is that question-first prompting helps patch-level perception but harms downstream answer formation. They propose prompt echoing, where the question is placed both before and after the image.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates across visual question answering benchmarks and compares question-first, image-first, and echoed prompts. The abstract reports consistent underperformance of question-first prompting and uses attention knockout to show that the answer token reads the question mainly when it follows the image; exact model names and gains are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Carnegie Mellon University. Deva Ramanan is a well-known computer vision researcher with substantial work on visual recognition and foundation-model-related vision systems.

recommendation.zh: 只看 probes 和 knockout；它提醒多模态预训练别只管视觉引导，还要保证答案 token 的晚期可访问性。
recommendation.en: Skim the probes and knockout; the useful lesson is to optimize both visual steering and late answer-token access in VLM layouts.

paper.title: COBS: Cumulant Order Block Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Block sparse attention is a hardware friendly way to alleviate the key-value (KV) cache read bottleneck in large language models (LLMs). However, it is not prevalent among leading open-weight LLMs, which rely instead on dense attention or fine-grained selection, thereby motivating our analysis. We study DeepSeek's Native Sparse Attention (NSA) as a representative method, whose three-branch design lets us isolate block selection, the most challenging and consequential stage. We formalize selectio

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究长上下文解码中的 KV cache 读取瓶颈，核心问题是：block sparse attention 很适合硬件连续读取，但真正难的是在不读取完整 block 的情况下，准确选出对当前 query 贡献最大的历史 block。
summary.importance: 它对长上下文 LLM 的高效注意力设计有直接启发。论文把 block selection 明确化为估计 block attention mass，即一个 block 内 attention score 的总贡献。这个视角比只比较稀疏 pattern 更有用，因为它说明了为什么 mean-pooling 这类一阶 selector 会失败：它只看 block key 的均值，忽略了 block 内 key 分布沿 query 方向的弯曲程度。对预训练研究的意义在于，如果长上下文稀疏注意力要进入模型架构或训练 recipe，selector 的统计摘要需要和注意力目标对齐，而不是只追求缓存小或实现简单。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 DeepSeek Native Sparse Attention 作为分析对象。NSA 有 compression、selection 和 sliding-window 三个分支，其中 selection branch 决定哪些远距离 block 会被全分辨率读取。作者先在明确假设下证明，若目标是保持 dense attention 输出，block ranking 可以归约为按 attention mass 排序。Oracle Sparse Attention 使用真实 mass 排序，实验上接近 dense attention，说明主要困难不在排序准则，而在如何便宜地估计 mass。COBS 从 cumulant expansion 出发近似 block 的 log-sum-exp 贡献。一阶项对应 query 与 block mean key 的内积；二阶项引入 block 内 key covariance，即 query 方向上的方差项。为控制开销，COBS 对每个 block 缓存压缩后的 covariance，包括低秩分解、query-subspace projection 和 FP4 quantization。选择阶段用这个二阶估计给 block 打分，再对 top-k block 做细粒度 attention。
summary.experiments: 主要结果来自 11-task、32k context 的 RULER 配置。NSA baseline 平均分为 0.2999，COBS 提升到 0.8195，dense attention 为 0.9040。按论文口径，COBS 补回了 NSA 与 dense attention 差距的约 86%。同时，它的 KV cache read traffic 只有 NSA baseline 的 1.21×，比 dense attention 少 15.15×。Oracle mass selection 接近 dense attention，支持 attention mass 是合理选择目标。消融实验用于分离 covariance 项、低秩压缩、query 子空间投影和量化等设计的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。Section 3 最重要，它把 block selection 归约为 attention mass ranking，并用 oracle 结果验证准则。Section 4 解释 cumulant expansion，重点看一阶 selector 丢掉了什么；这里是论文的核心洞察。Section 5 看 COBS 如何缓存和压缩 covariance，注意额外 cache 开销与读取流量的取舍。Section 7 和 Figure 1 看 RULER 结果、traffic 对比和消融。需要带着一个问题读：这些 block-level 统计是否适合在预训练时固定进架构，还是更适合作为推理时的 cache-side 增强。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the KV-cache read bottleneck in long-context decoding. The central question is how to make hardware-friendly block sparse attention work: before reading a full block, the model needs a cheap selector that can identify the blocks contributing most to the current query.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to efficient long-context LLM design. It frames block selection as estimating block attention mass, the total attention contribution of a block. This is a more precise target than comparing sparse patterns alone. It also explains why first-order selectors based on mean-pooled keys can fail: they capture the block mean but ignore how the keys vary along the query direction. For pretraining and architecture work, the implication is that sparse-attention summaries should be matched to the attention objective, not only to cache size or implementation convenience.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses DeepSeek Native Sparse Attention as the reference system. NSA combines a compression branch, a selection branch, and a sliding-window branch; the paper isolates the selection branch because it decides which distant blocks are read at full resolution. Under explicit assumptions, the authors reduce output-preserving block selection to ranking blocks by attention mass. An oracle selector using exact mass nearly matches dense attention, which suggests that the main problem is estimating the mass cheaply. COBS derives a second-order selector from a cumulant expansion of the block contribution. The first-order term is the query dot product with the block mean key. The second-order term uses the within-block key covariance, capturing variance in the query direction. To keep the cache practical, COBS stores a compressed covariance per block using low-rank factorization, query-subspace projection, and FP4 quantization, then selects top-k blocks for fine-grained attention.
summary_en.experiments: On an 11-task 32k-context RULER configuration, the NSA baseline scores 0.2999 on average, COBS reaches 0.8195, and dense attention reaches 0.9040. By the authors' calculation, COBS closes about 86% of the gap between NSA and dense attention. Its KV-cache read traffic is only 1.21× that of the NSA baseline and 15.15× lower than dense attention. The oracle mass selector performs close to dense attention, supporting attention mass as the right selection target. Ablations separate the effects of the covariance term, compression choices, query-subspace projection, and quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Section 3 is the key part: it formalizes block selection as attention-mass ranking and validates the criterion with an oracle. Section 4 explains the cumulant view and why first-order selectors miss an important second-order term. Section 5 gives the practical COBS design, especially how covariance is cached and compressed. Section 7 and Figure 1 are useful for the RULER results, traffic comparison, and ablations. The main question to keep in mind is whether these block-level statistics should be built into a pretrained long-context architecture or used as an inference-side cache enhancement.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是问题拆解，不是名字里的新算法；先看它把 block selection 归约成 attention mass 的论证，再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the problem decomposition, not the new acronym; read the attention-mass reduction first, then decide whether it merits reproduction.

paper.title: MemDefrag: Latent Memory Defragmentation for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Latent memory, which stores past knowledge fragments as per-layer hidden states, has emerged as a promising paradigm (e.g., MemoryLLM and M+) for long-term memory in large language models (LLMs). However, the paradigm suffers from significant performance degradation during memory updates, due to positional encoding misalignment and the absence of any tracing mechanism to distinguish target memory fragments from irrelevant ones. To discover such a tracing mechanism, we probe the layer-wise attent

summary.core_problem: 基于“latent memory（以各层 hidden states 存储记忆片段）”的长时记忆 LLM 在更新/写入记忆后容易性能退化，如何在不训练的情况下缓解由位置编码错位与无追踪机制导致的记忆污染。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制探测 + 训练外（training-free）记忆管理：指出中间层对目标记忆片段存在稳定的注意力密度“追踪信号”，并用它做记忆碎片整理与遗忘；对做 MemoryLLM/M+ 这类架构的人有直接工程启发，但对通用预训练主线影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 先做 probing：统计 layer-wise attention density 在存储的 memory fragments 上的分布，发现少数中间层对目标片段注意力最集中；据此提出 MemDefrag：用中间层信号对记忆做 rank/reorder/filter 的“defragmentation”，并在容量不足时用 informativeness-guided 的 proportional forgetting 做删减；强调 model-agnostic、training-free。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基座、任务、记忆容量、退化幅度与修复幅度；从表述看会在 MemoryLLM/M+ 风格设置下对比更新前后性能，以及 MemDefrag 对更新退化的缓解效果与容量扩展曲线。
summary.authors_note: Kyoto University；其余作者含 Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: Latent-memory LLMs (storing memory as per-layer hidden states) often degrade after memory updates due to positional-encoding misalignment and lack of a tracing mechanism; the goal is to mitigate this without additional training.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism probing plus a training-free memory-management method: it claims a stable mid-layer attention-density “tracing signal” for target fragments and uses it for defragmentation/forgetting. Useful if you build MemoryLLM/M+-style systems, less central to mainstream pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Probe layer-wise attention density over stored memory fragments and identify a small set of middle layers that consistently concentrate attention on the target fragment. Propose MemDefrag: use this mid-layer signal to rank/reorder/filter memories (defragmentation) and apply an informativeness-guided proportional forgetting when capacity is exceeded; model-agnostic and training-free.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model/task/capacity numbers. Likely evaluates update-induced degradation in MemoryLLM/M+-like setups and measures how MemDefrag restores performance and scales with memory capacity.
summary_en.authors_note: Kyoto University; one author listed as Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 中间层注意力密度当“记忆追踪信号”这个观察值得记一笔；但缺少规模化实验细节时先别信泛化，只需扫它的 probing 图和整理策略。
recommendation.en: The mid-layer attention-density “memory tracing” observation is worth noting; without large, clean experiments don’t over-believe generality—skim the probing plots and the defrag heuristic.

paper.title: Propose and Attend: Training-free MLLM Grounding Confidence via Multi-Token Localized Attention
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models can emit localized predictions, bounding boxes for objects and temporal windows for video and audio events, but they hallucinate these regions prolifically. The model's own token log-probabilities are nearly uninformative: they conflate grounding quality with input ambiguity, and coordinate tokens become near-deterministic once the model commits. We propose Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA): a training-free, post-hoc score that measures how strongly a predic

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 MLLM 生成定位结果时缺少可靠置信度的问题。模型可以直接输出 bbox 或时间窗口，但大量区域并不对应真实对象或事件；生成 token 的 log-prob 又不能有效区分正确定位和幻觉定位，因为坐标 token 在模型决定输出后往往变得近似确定。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的贡献偏间接，但对多模态模型训练和评测很有用。核心启发是：定位是否可靠，可以从生成 token 对其声称区域内模态 token 的注意力支持程度中读出，而不是只看文本概率。这个信号可用于 MLLM grounding 评测、推理时重排序、训练数据过滤，也可能为后续构造视觉 grounding reward 提供一个无需额外标注的 proxy。论文还提醒，通用 MLLM 如果要作为定位系统使用，需要用检测领域的 AP、Recall@1、PSDS1 等指标来评估，而不能只看 VQA 或 caption 类 benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Multi-Token Localized Attention，简称 MTLA。给定模型生成的一个定位预测，例如类别标签加 bbox，或音视频中的时间窗口，MTLA 收集所有相关输出 token 的 decoder attention，并只统计这些 token 对预测区域内部模态 token 的注意力质量。它同时改进了两个常见弱点：第一，不再像 SVAR 类方法那样把注意力在整个视觉输入上求和，而是限制在模型自己声称的区域内；第二，不只读取第一个对象词 token，而是聚合整个预测的多个 token，包括语义标签和坐标/时间 token。这样得到的分数衡量的是“这个预测是否真的由其所指区域支撑”。方法不需要训练额外分类器，也不需要改模型结构，可用于图像、视频和音频定位。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个模型族和多个模态上验证 MTLA，包括图像目标定位、视频事件定位和音频事件定位。作者首先指出，当前强 MLLM 输出的定位区域中有 58% 到 68% 不能匹配有效对象或事件，说明定位幻觉比例很高。token probability 对正确与错误定位的区分度很弱。MTLA 在幻觉检测、训练自由的输出抑制和检测指标重排序中都优于已有 attention baseline。一个明确数字是：在 COCO zero-shot detection 上，对一个 8B generalist MLLM，把 MTLA 作为置信度后，AP 从 20.4 提升到 37.0。论文还使用 AP、Recall@1 和 PSDS1 等标准定位指标，而不是只用生成式任务指标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Introduction 中关于 log-prob 失效和 58%–68% 无效定位的分析，这是问题成立的关键。然后看 MTLA 定义，重点是“localized”和“multi-token”两个设计；它们分别对应区域内注意力和跨预测 token 聚合。实验部分优先看 Figure 4，理解 token probability 与 MTLA 的分离度差异；再看 COCO AP 20.4 到 37.0 的重排序结果，以及跨图像、视频、音频的泛化表。若只关心预训练，可把它当作一个 grounding 信号候选，而不是一篇训练 recipe 论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies confidence estimation for localization outputs generated by MLLMs. These models can emit boxes for images and temporal windows for video or audio, but many predicted regions are hallucinated. Token log-probabilities are a poor confidence signal because they mix grounding quality with input ambiguity, and coordinate tokens often become nearly deterministic once the model commits to a region.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining recipe, but it is useful for multimodal foundation-model research. It shows that grounding quality can be probed from how strongly the generated prediction tokens attend to the region they claim. This gives a training-free signal for localization reliability, output reranking, data filtering, and possibly reward construction for future grounding-oriented post-training. It also argues that MLLMs used as localization systems should be evaluated with detection-style metrics such as AP, Recall@1, and PSDS1, not only with VQA or captioning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed score, Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA), is a post-hoc confidence measure. For a predicted region, MTLA aggregates decoder attention from all tokens belonging to the prediction and restricts the modality-side aggregation to tokens inside the predicted box or temporal window. This differs from earlier attention-based hallucination detectors in two ways. It is localized: attention outside the claimed region is not treated as direct evidence. It is multi-token: the score uses the full prediction, including label and coordinate or time tokens, rather than a single object sub-token. The resulting score measures whether the prediction is supported by evidence in the region it points to. It requires no additional training and is intended to work across image, video, and audio localization.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover several model families and localization settings across modalities. A key empirical finding is that 58% to 68% of regions emitted by strong MLLMs do not correspond to valid objects or events on the evaluated benchmarks. Token probability provides weak separation between grounded and hallucinated predictions. MTLA improves hallucination detection, enables training-free suppression of unreliable outputs, and improves ranking under standard localization metrics. The clearest reported number is on zero-shot COCO detection: using MTLA as the confidence score raises AP for an 8B generalist MLLM from 20.4 to 37.0. The paper also evaluates with AP, Recall@1, and PSDS1, which makes the localization behavior easier to compare with detector-style systems.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 20 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure analysis of token log-probabilities and the reported 58%–68% invalid localization rate. Then read the MTLA formulation, paying attention to the two design choices: region-restricted attention and aggregation over all prediction tokens. In the experiments, Figure 4 is important because it compares the separation quality of token probability and MTLA. Also inspect the COCO AP reranking result and the tables covering image, video, and audio. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is MTLA as a candidate grounding signal, not as a model-training method.

recommendation.zh: 多模态定位幻觉的无训练校准信号，方法简单且跨模态通用，做VLM对齐/评测的可直接复用，只看方法定义与Fig2即可。
recommendation.en: A simple, training-free, modality-agnostic calibration signal for MLLM grounding hallucination; reusable for VLM alignment/evaluation, read method definition and Fig 2 only.

paper.title: MultAttnAttrib: Training-Free Multimodal Attribution in Long Document Question Answering
paper.abstract: As grounded QA systems are increasingly deployed in AI assistants, accurately attributing generated answers to evidence is critical for user trust and model safety. While unimodal attributions have been explored in depth, the multimodal setting remains relatively under-researched. As a result, we introduce MultAttnAttrib, a training-free attribution-generation method that leverages a model's prefill pass, selected attention heads, and calibrated thresholds to locate source evidence within a docu

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态长文档 QA 中答案片段如何自动归因到原始证据位置的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个 training-free 多模态归因方法和一个细粒度归因评测集。它与 VLM 可靠性、长上下文证据定位和 grounded generation 有关，但不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MultAttnAttrib，利用模型 prefill pass 中的注意力信息，选择特定 attention heads，并通过校准阈值定位文档中的证据区域。方法不训练额外模型，依赖已有多模态模型内部注意力作为归因信号。同时提出 MultAttrEval，用于评估答案组件到多模态源文档证据的细粒度映射。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 MultAttnAttrib 在 MultAttrEval 上稳定优于多种 attribution-generation baseline，包括若干强基线；未给出具体 VLM、文档长度、数据规模、指标和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to attribute answer components in multimodal long-document QA back to their supporting evidence in the source document.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a training-free multimodal attribution method with a fine-grained attribution evaluation dataset. It is relevant to VLM reliability, long-context grounding, and evidence localization, but it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: MultAttnAttrib uses attention signals from the model's prefill pass, selects specific attention heads, and applies calibrated thresholds to locate evidence regions in multimodal documents. It requires no additional training. The paper also introduces MultAttrEval, a dataset with ground-truth fine-grained attributions from answer components to multimodal source evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that MultAttnAttrib consistently outperforms several attribution-generation baselines on MultAttrEval, including strong baselines. It does not specify the VLMs, document lengths, dataset size, metrics, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 长文档 VLM grounding 的工具性工作；只看 attention-head 选择和阈值校准细节，不必追实验排名。
recommendation.en: A tooling paper for long-document VLM grounding; skim the head-selection and threshold-calibration details, not the leaderboard claims.

paper.title: Dismantling Pathological Shortcuts: A Causal Framework for Faithful LVLM Decoding
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit sophisticated reasoning but remain susceptible to object hallucination. Deviating from the prevailing attention intensity assumption, we reveal a deeper dynamic structural misalignment: hallucination is triggered at decision-critical steps where specific attention heads, acting as risky mediators, decouple from visual evidence to lock onto language priors. This establishes a pathological shortcut that bypasses visual grounding. To dismantle this, we p

summary.core_problem: 解决大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中对象幻觉的问题，修正现有方法基于注意力强度假设的偏差。
summary.importance: 原理分析（揭示LVLM幻觉的新机制）+ 方法创新（训练自由的推理干预框架），修正了领域对幻觉成因的主流假设。
summary.technical_approach: 1）揭示幻觉源于决策关键步的特定注意力头（风险中介）与视觉证据脱钩、锁死语言先验的结构错位，而非注意力强度不足；2）提出Fox框架：用视觉注意力熵探针无监督定位风险中介，通过对数饱和做因果干预切断捷径，再用冲突门控协同解码平衡忠实度与流畅度。
summary.experiments: 在多个LVLM对象幻觉评测集上验证，显著降低幻觉率的同时保持生成流畅度；基于开源LVLM骨干做实验，未提及自训基座。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses object hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) and corrects biases in existing methods based on the attention intensity assumption.
summary_en.importance: Combines mechanism analysis (revealing a novel LVLM hallucination mechanism) with methodological innovation (training-free inference intervention framework), correcting the mainstream prior on hallucination causes.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Reveals hallucination stems from structural misalignment: specific attention heads (risky mediators) decouple from visual evidence and lock onto language priors at decision-critical steps, rather than insufficient attention intensity; 2) Proposes Fox: uses a visual attention entropy probe to unsupervisedly locate risky mediators, applies causal intervention via logit saturation to sever shortcuts, and uses a conflict-gated cooperative decoding strategy to balance faithfulness and fluency.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple LVLM object hallucination benchmarks, significantly reducing hallucination rates while preserving generation fluency; experiments run on open-source LVLM backbones, no self-trained foundation models disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 推翻LVLM幻觉的注意力强度假设，结构错位的机制可直接指导预训练阶段的视觉-语言对齐头设计，重点读§3的机制分析。
recommendation.en: Overturns the attention intensity prior for LVLM hallucination; the structural misalignment mechanism can directly guide vision-language alignment head design during pretraining, focus on Section 3 mechanism analysis.

paper.title: Diagnosing Task Insensitivity in Language Agents
paper.abstract: Large language models can serve as capable long-horizon agents, but their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains weak. We identify a key source of this failure as task insensitivity: when faced with similar but distinct tasks, models might apply patterns learned during training and fail to solve the task at hand. We show that models often continue with actions aligned with the original task even when the instruction is semantically corrupted and cannot be directly answered. We further

summary.core_problem: 诊断 LLM agent 在相似但不同任务上的 OOD 泛化失败，核心现象是模型对当前任务指令不敏感，继续执行训练中学到的动作模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏机制分析加轻量训练改进。它把 agent 失败从“能力不足”拆成一个更具体的优化偏置：模型在训练中逐渐依赖局部观察和历史模式，而不是任务 token。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计两类扰动诊断：一是把指令语义破坏到不可回答，观察模型是否仍输出原任务动作；二是在已训练 prompt 中替换为相似但不同的任务，检查动作是否保持不变。随后提出 Task-Perturbed NLL Optimization，用任务扰动形成对比式正则，显式提高动作对任务指令的依赖。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、环境类型、数据量和具体提升数字。实验重点应是跨 checkpoint 行为分析、任务 token 注意力漂移曲线，以及加入 Task-Perturbed NLL 后对任务替换/语义破坏的鲁棒性变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses OOD failures in LLM agents where similar but distinct tasks trigger the same learned action pattern because the agent becomes insensitive to the current task instruction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly behavioral diagnosis with a lightweight training fix. It narrows a broad agent-generalization issue into an optimization shortcut: trained agents shift reliance from task tokens toward local observations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use task perturbations as probes: corrupting the instruction so it is no longer answerable, and replacing the task description with a nearby but different task inside a trained prompt. They then introduce Task-Perturbed NLL Optimization, a contrastive regularizer that encourages the predicted action to depend on task semantics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, environment details, dataset scale, or numerical gains. The likely evidence centers on checkpoint-wise action invariance, attention drift away from task tokens, and robustness improvements after applying the task-perturbed regularizer.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 训练捷径的诊断信号可以看，重点读任务替换实验；正则方法像补丁，别过度外推到通用对齐。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick read for the shortcut-diagnosis setup; focus on the task-replacement probes, while treating the regularizer as a local patch rather than a general alignment result.

paper.title: Listening makes Vision Clear for VLMs
paper.abstract: Recent work typically assesses vision--language consistency using attention distributions of answer-side tokens. However, we observe that highest attention regions are not always consistent with the intended semantic token. This probably stems from decoding drift, where language priors from previously generated answer tokens accumulate and mismatch with visual attention. Besides the priors from previous answer tokens, we find that structural tokens, e.g., modality boundary markers, may encompass

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM视觉-语言一致性评估依赖答案生成侧token的注意力分布，受解码过程的语言先验和特殊token干扰，无法准确反映模型真实的视觉对齐情况。
summary.importance: 识别了VLM注意力评估中的两类系统性偏差来源，提出基于提示侧语义的激活图度量，提升VLM视觉-语言一致性评估的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Prompt-Vision Token Activation Map（PV-TAM），使用提示侧语义token而非生成侧答案token的注意力关联视觉区域，加入过滤器去除模态边界标记等结构token引入的系统偏差，结合激活强度的峰值分布而非仅mask重叠计算一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未给出在具体VLM模型上的量化评估结果，仅描述了传统方法的偏差来源和新度量的核心设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language consistency evaluation for VLMs relies on attention distributions of answer-side tokens, which is distorted by decoding-time language priors and special token interference, failing to reflect true visual alignment.
summary_en.importance: Identifies two systematic bias sources in VLM attention evaluation, and proposes a prompt-side activation map metric to improve the reliability of vision-language consistency measurement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Prompt-Vision Token Activation Map (PV-TAM), which uses prompt-side semantic tokens instead of generated answer tokens to associate visual regions, adds a filter to remove systematic bias from structural tokens like modality boundary markers, and leverages peak activation distribution rather than mask overlap alone to measure consistency.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, no quantitative evaluation results on specific VLMs are provided, only the bias sources of existing methods and core design of the new metric are described.

recommendation.zh: 指出VLM答案侧注意力的解码漂移与特殊token偏差问题，对多模态预训练注意力设计有弱参考，只看偏差分析段。
recommendation.en: Identifies answer-side attention drift and special token bias in VLMs, weak reference for multimodal pretraining attention design, only read the bias analysis section.

paper.title: Does RoPE Prevent or Degrade Retrieval Heads? A Mechanistic Analysis Across Model Families
paper.abstract: Retrieval heads, attention heads that copy information from earlier context to the current position, have been proposed as the mechanistic substrate for long-context recall. Rotary position embeddings (RoPE) rotate queries and keys by frequencies decaying with a base hyperparameter theta, and a natural hypothesis is that this rotation either prevents retrieval heads from forming or degrades their function. We test both across four open-weight 7-8B models spanning multi-head and grouped-query att

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 RoPE 是否会阻止或削弱 long-context retrieval heads。更具体地说，它检验两个常见直觉：较大的 RoPE base θ 是否会减少 retrieval heads 的形成；以及 RoPE 维度的 query-projection norm utility 是否能解释哪些维度对检索回忆真正有因果作用。
summary.importance: 这是 long-context 预训练和机制分析方向值得精读的工作。它把 RoPE context extension、retrieval heads、维度级因果消融放在同一个受控实验框架里，结论对训练 recipe 有直接含义：提高 θ 并不等于会破坏检索电路；用投影范数定义的“低效维度”也不能简单当作可删除空间。更可靠的信号是 RoPE frequency 本身，检索依赖的是 low-frequency dimensions。对做长上下文预训练的人来说，这改变了诊断重点：不要只看困惑度或 needle accuracy，也不要只用范数 proxy 判断 RoPE 维度价值，而要看具体 attention heads 与频率子空间之间的因果关系。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕两个假设设计机制实验。H1 是 prevention hypothesis：更大的 θ，也就是更慢衰减的旋转频率，会减少 retrieval heads 的形成。H2 是 degradation hypothesis：Chiang & Yogatama 使用的 query-projection norm utility 可以标出检索依赖的 RoPE 维度，低 utility 维度应当可安全置零，高 utility 维度应当承载检索能力。实验覆盖四个 7–8B 开源模型：LLaMA-3.1-8B，GQA，θ=500,000；LLaMA-2-7B，MHA，θ=10,000；Qwen2.5-7B，GQA，θ=1,000,000；OLMo-2-7B，MHA，θ=500,000。这个选择同时覆盖 MHA/GQA 和 100× 的 RoPE base 范围。方法上分成三个阶段：Layer A 做多模型静态检测，用 paired-seed needle-in-a-haystack 协议，让不同模型在 tokenizer-independent 的同一批样本上比较，避免输入差异污染结论；Layer B 追踪 OLMo-2 训练过程中的 retrieval head emergence；Layer D 做因果验证，包括 whole-head knockout、RoPE 维度置零、matched random controls 和 non-retrieval-head controls。统计上使用 layer-clustered permutation、layer-controlled partial correlation 和 cross-model FDR，重点是避免把同一层内相关样本当成独立样本。
summary.experiments: 核心结果是否定了两个简单解释。第一，H1 没有得到支持：θ 从 10,000 到 1,000,000 的变化没有阻止 retrieval heads 出现，也没有形成“θ 越大，head 越少”的稳定关系。第二，H2 也不成立：query-projection norm utility 与检索所需维度并不一致。因果消融显示，retrieval heads 真正依赖的是 low-frequency RoPE dimensions，而不是简单由 norm utility 标出的高 utility 维度。论文还报告 whole-head knockout 的 double dissociation：消融 retrieval heads 会显著破坏长上下文回忆，而消融匹配的非 retrieval heads 不产生同等影响；这个现象在两个模型家族中复现。OLMo-2 的训练动态分析说明 retrieval heads 是训练中形成的可追踪电路，而不是只在最终 checkpoint 上人为定义出来的现象。维度级实验加入随机维度和非检索头对照、frequency-aware ordering、dose-response curve 和多 seed 显著性检验，增强了“频率比范数 proxy 更能解释检索依赖”的结论。已给出的全文片段没有列出具体 head count、每个模型的精确 recall drop 或置信区间，精读时需要回到相应结果表和图中核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Table 1，确认四个模型的 attention regime、RoPE base 和规模差异。然后看 Section 3.5 的 paired-seed needle-in-a-haystack 协议，这是结果可信度的基础；重点检查样本如何做到 tokenizer-independent、retrieval head 如何定义、head 选择阈值如何设定。Section 4 用来判断 H1，关注 θ 与 retrieval head count 的关系，不要只看总体趋势，要看分模型和分层分布。Section 5 看 OLMo-2 训练动态，重点是 retrieval heads 在训练中何时出现、是否与长上下文能力同步变化。Section 6 是核心，重点看 whole-head knockout、RoPE frequency 维度置零、norm utility 对照、dose-response curve，以及随机和非检索头控制组。最值得深挖的是两个技术细节：一是 RoPE 维度消融到底作用在 Q/K 的哪一部分，是否改变归一化或激活尺度；二是统计检验如何处理 layer 内相关性，这直接影响显著性结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether RoPE prevents or weakens retrieval heads, the attention heads thought to copy information from earlier context during long-context recall. It tests two specific claims: whether larger RoPE base θ reduces the formation of retrieval heads, and whether query-projection norm utility identifies the RoPE dimensions that retrieval actually depends on.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong read for long-context pretraining and mechanistic analysis. It connects three issues that are often studied separately: RoPE context extension, retrieval-head circuits, and dimension-level causal ablation. The main practical implication is that increasing θ does not appear to block retrieval circuits, and norm-based RoPE utility is not a reliable proxy for retrieval dependence. For long-context model development, the diagnostic target should shift from aggregate needle accuracy or projection norms toward causal interactions between specific heads and RoPE frequency subspaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study is organized around two hypotheses. H1, the prevention hypothesis, predicts that larger θ should reduce the number of retrieval heads. H2, the degradation hypothesis, predicts that the query-projection norm utility from Chiang and Yogatama should separate load-bearing RoPE dimensions from removable ones. The experiments cover four open 7–8B models: LLaMA-3.1-8B with GQA and θ=500,000; LLaMA-2-7B with MHA and θ=10,000; Qwen2.5-7B with GQA and θ=1,000,000; and OLMo-2-7B with MHA and θ=500,000. This gives both attention-regime variation and a 100× range of RoPE bases. The pipeline has three stages. Layer A performs static multi-model detection with a paired-seed needle-in-a-haystack protocol, using tokenizer-independent samples so model comparisons are not confounded by different inputs. Layer B studies the training-time emergence of retrieval heads in OLMo-2. Layer D performs causal validation through whole-head knockouts and RoPE-dimension interventions, with matched random and non-retrieval-head controls. The statistical treatment uses layer-clustered permutation tests, layer-controlled partial correlations, and cross-model FDR to avoid pseudoreplication.
summary_en.experiments: The main results reject both simple stories. H1 is not supported: varying θ from 10,000 to 1,000,000 does not prevent retrieval heads from forming and does not yield a stable monotonic relationship between θ and retrieval-head count. H2 is also not supported: query-projection norm utility does not reliably identify the RoPE dimensions that retrieval needs. Causal ablations indicate that retrieval heads depend on low-frequency RoPE dimensions, rather than on the dimensions marked as high-utility by the norm proxy. Whole-head knockout experiments show a double dissociation: removing retrieval heads damages long-context recall, while matched non-retrieval heads do not have the same effect, and this pattern is replicated across two model families. The OLMo-2 checkpoint analysis shows that retrieval heads emerge during training as trackable circuits, rather than being only a post-hoc label on final models. The dimension-level experiments include random controls, non-retrieval-head controls, frequency-aware ordering, dose-response curves, and multi-seed significance tests. The provided text does not expose the exact head counts, recall-drop magnitudes, or confidence intervals, so those should be checked directly in the result tables and figures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with Table 1 to fix the model set, attention regimes, RoPE bases, and scale. Then read Section 3.5 carefully; the paired-seed needle-in-a-haystack design is the basis for the cross-model claims. Check how tokenizer-independent samples are constructed, how retrieval heads are detected, and what thresholds are used. Section 4 is the key section for H1; inspect per-model and per-layer head distributions rather than only aggregate trends. Section 5 is useful for understanding when retrieval heads appear during OLMo-2 training. Section 6 is the core causal section: focus on whole-head knockouts, RoPE frequency ablations, norm-utility controls, dose-response curves, and the random and non-retrieval-head baselines. Two details are worth extra scrutiny: where exactly the RoPE-dimension ablation is applied in Q/K space, and how the layer-clustered statistics change the significance of the claims.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变对RoPE theta超参与检索头形成的认知，应立刻在内部长上下文ablation中复现头掩码和theta对比实验
recommendation.en: Directly alters prior on RoPE theta hyperparameter and retrieval head formation, immediately replicate head masking and theta comparison in internal long-context ablations

paper.title: Protein contacts are already in the attention: a single-forward-pass alternative to the Categorical Jacobian
paper.abstract: The Categorical Jacobian (CJ) of Zhang et al. (2024) reads protein contacts from a language model by perturbing every residue with every alternative amino acid, about 19L forward passes. We show the signal it reconstructs is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads: averaging the top-K contact-relevant heads, selected on as few as 10 labeled proteins, recovers contacts in one forward pass and beats CJ on leakage-clean data for every bidirectional model where CJ is defined, and m

summary.core_problem: 从蛋白质语言模型中无监督读出残基接触的 Categorical Jacobian 方法需要 ~19L 次前向传播，计算成本高且仅适用于带 MLM 分类头的双向掩码模型。
summary.importance: 证明蛋白质接触信号已经集中在少量注意力头中，仅用 10 个标注蛋白做头选择、再对 top-K 头做无加权平均，即可在单次前向传播内得到优于或匹配 Categorical Jacobian 的结果，且能扩展到编码器-解码器架构。同时在 leakage-clean 评测下，两种无监督方法的性能都比之前的报告值下降 30–36 个百分点，量化了预训练数据与评测集序列重叠对结果的高估程度，对预训练表征的可解释性和评测严谨性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法非常简洁：先用一个仅含 10 条蛋白的小标注集，按接触预测精度对所有注意力头排序，选出 top-K 头；推理时直接对这些头的注意力图做无加权算术平均，得到接触预测图。不需要回归拟合、不需要逐对标注、不需要多次前向扰动。作为补充，论文还提出 Representation-CJ，把原本依赖 logit 的 Categorical Jacobian 推广到隐藏状态空间，使其可用于没有 MLM 头的架构；并在因果语言模型上验证了两种方法都失效，与双向预训练对成对结构编码的重要性一致。
summary.experiments: 核心结果在 leakage-clean 的 CAMEO-PTA25 分割（仅使用模型预训练截止日期之后提交、并做序列去重的蛋白链）上得到：ESM-2-650M 上，单次前向的注意力头融合优于 Categorical Jacobian，且此时 CJ 也不再优于单个最优注意力头。该模式在 ESM-2-650M、ESM-2-3B、ProtT5-XL 三种架构上复现；在 Zhang eval-200 和 CASP14-FM 上扩展到共 5 种掩码 LM 和编码器-解码器架构，除最小的 8M 模型和 ESM Cambrian（统计持平）外，融合方法均匹配或优于 CJ。从 Zhang eval-200 换到 leakage-clean CAMEO 后，两种方法的绝对精度都下降 30–36 个百分点。因果 LM（ProGen2 系列）上两种方法均无有效信号。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第 4.1 节 leakage-clean 评测下的主对比结果，以及第 4.4 节关于因果 LM 失效的讨论——后者对理解不同预训练目标（双向 vs 因果）如何编码成对依赖有直接启发。方法部分非常短，可快速浏览；附录中的 head precision 排序和 K 的选择消融值得看。全文泛读约 35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The Categorical Jacobian, an unsupervised method for reading residue contacts from protein language models, requires ~19L forward passes and is structurally limited to bidirectional masked-LM architectures with a per-position MLM head.
summary_en.importance: Shows that protein contact signal is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads. Head selection on as few as 10 labeled proteins, followed by an unweighted average of the top-K heads, matches or outperforms the Categorical Jacobian in a single forward pass and generalizes to encoder–decoder architectures. Critically, under leakage-clean evaluation both unsupervised methods drop 30–36 absolute percentage points relative to previously reported numbers, quantifying how much sequence overlap between pretraining and evaluation inflates prior results. The findings are relevant for interpretability of pretrained representations and for rigorous evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is deliberately minimal. First, rank all attention heads by contact precision on a small held-out set of only 10 labeled proteins and select the top-K. At inference, take the unweighted arithmetic mean of their attention maps as the contact prediction. No per-pair regression, no per-pair labels, and no multiple perturbed forward passes are needed. As a secondary contribution, the paper introduces Representation-CJ, a hidden-state generalization of the original logit-based Categorical Jacobian that extends to architectures without an MLM head. It also verifies that both methods fail on causal LMs, consistent with the hypothesis that bidirectional pretraining is important for encoding pairwise structural constraints in attention.
summary_en.experiments: The central result is on the leakage-clean CAMEO-PTA25 split (chains deposited after each model's pretraining cutoff and filtered for sequence similarity). On ESM-2-650M, single-forward-pass head fusion beats the Categorical Jacobian, and CJ itself no longer outperforms the single best attention head. This pattern reproduces across ESM-2-650M, ESM-2-3B, and ProtT5-XL. Across five masked-LM and encoder–decoder PLMs evaluated on Zhang eval-200 and CASP14-FM, fusion matches or exceeds CJ everywhere except the smallest 8M model and ESM Cambrian (statistical tie). Moving from Zhang eval-200 to leakage-clean CAMEO reduces absolute precision of both methods by 30–36 pp. Neither method produces a usable signal on causal ProGen2 models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4.1 for the main leakage-clean comparison, and Section 4.4 for the causal-LM failure case — the latter directly informs how different pretraining objectives (bidirectional vs causal) encode pairwise dependencies. The method section is short and can be skimmed quickly. Ablations on head-precision ranking and choice of K in the appendix are worth reading. Estimated reading time: ~35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 注意力头可线性读出结构化信号的结论对通用LLM的可解释性有类比价值，重点看 §4 头选择消融与泄露控制设置。
recommendation.en: The finding that structured signals can be linearly read out from attention heads carries analogies to general LLM interpretability; focus on §4 head-selection ablations and the leakage-controlled setup.

paper.title: LIG: Layer-wise Integrated Gradients for Within-Layer Flow Analysis in Transformers
paper.abstract: Transformers achieve strong performance, but their internal computations remain opaque. We view each Transformer layer as a dynamic graph whose nodes are token representations and per-head attention outputs, with Multi-Head Attention (ATT) and MLP as module boundaries. On this graph we use LIG (Layer-wise Integrated Gradients), which applies set-to-set Integrated Gradients (IG) at nonlinear module boundaries. Set-to-set IG applies IG to a map from a set of input token representations to a set of

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 Transformer 层内归因问题：不只解释输入 token 对最终输出的贡献，也不只看 attention map，而是把同一层里的 ATT 和 MLP 分开，分析 token 表示在层内如何流动、混合和再组织。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座模型机制分析有一定参考价值。它把归因粒度推进到层内模块边界，适合用来观察不同层的角色分化，例如浅层偏局部关系、深层偏全句整合。对预训练研究的启发主要在诊断层面：可用于比较架构、训练阶段、数据分布变化下的信息流差异。但贡献仍偏解释工具，实验集中在 BERT Base，离直接改进训练 recipe 还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把一个 Transformer layer 看成动态计算图。图上的节点包括每个 token 的层输入表示 z，以及每个 head 的 attention 输出 u。层内计算被拆成 z -> ATT -> u -> MLP -> z_next 两段。核心是 LIG，即在 ATT 和 MLP 这些非线性模块边界上使用 set-to-set Integrated Gradients。普通 IG 通常针对一个标量输出做归因；这里把一组输入 token 表示映射到一组输出表示，并用 L2 scalarization 把向量输出转成可求 IG 的标量目标，从而得到 token-to-token 的贡献矩阵。之后再把 ATT 段和 MLP 段的贡献组合起来，形式上接近 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation 的守恒思路。论文还比较了不同 baseline。结论是 MLP baseline 的选择影响相对小，ATT baseline 是主要影响因素；继承 ATT 输出端点 a=0 作为 MLP baseline，或使用 Zero，在归一化 L2 诊断下表现较好。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 BERT Base Uncased，配置为 12 层、12 个 attention heads、隐藏维度 768。实验主要验证两类问题：一是分段归因 ATT + MLP 的组合路径是否能和整层 z-to-z 归因保持一致；二是 baseline 选择对归因结果的影响。论文用 normalized L2 指标比较不同配置，发现 ATT baseline 主导整体误差，而 MLP baseline 的影响较弱。可视化结果展示了 token-to-token 贡献随层深变化的模式：早期层更容易看到局部或邻近 token 关系，较深层出现更广的句子级整合。整体实验偏诊断和定性分析，不是大规模模型机制发现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟。优先看 Transformer graph 定义和 LIG 公式部分，确认 set-to-set IG 如何从标量 IG 扩展到 token 集合映射。然后看 baseline 消融和 normalized L2 结果，理解为什么 ATT baseline 比 MLP baseline 更关键。最后看层级可视化图，判断这种工具是否适合自己的模型诊断场景。若关注 LLM pretrain 训练动态，可重点思考它能否用于比较 checkpoint、数据阶段或架构改动，而不是只停留在单个 BERT 样例解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses within-layer attribution in Transformers: instead of explaining only input-to-output relevance or visualizing attention maps, it separates ATT and MLP and tracks how token representations flow through a single layer.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability paper rather than a pretraining method. Its value for foundation-model research is diagnostic. It offers a way to inspect how information routing changes across depth and how attention and MLP contribute differently to token-to-token interactions. The impact is moderate: useful for mechanism analysis and training-dynamics studies, but not directly tied to scaling, data mixture, or optimization recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method models each Transformer layer as a dynamic graph with token representations z and per-head attention outputs u as nodes. A layer is decomposed into z -> ATT -> u -> MLP -> z_next. LIG applies Integrated Gradients at these module boundaries. Since standard IG usually attributes a scalar objective, the paper extends it to set-to-set maps by using an L2 scalarization over vector outputs, producing token-to-token contribution scores. The ATT and MLP attributions are then composed in a way similar to the conservation intuition behind Layer-wise Relevance Propagation. The paper also studies baseline choices. Under the normalized L2 diagnostic, the ATT baseline dominates the attribution quality, while the MLP baseline has a much smaller effect; inheriting the ATT endpoint at a=0 as the MLP baseline or using Zero ranks among the better configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use BERT Base Uncased with 12 layers, 12 heads, and hidden size 768. The main checks are whether the decomposed ATT-plus-MLP path aligns with direct whole-layer z-to-z attribution, and how baseline choices affect the normalized L2 consistency metric. The qualitative visualizations show a depth-dependent shift: lower layers emphasize more local token relations, while higher layers show broader sentence-level integration. The evidence is mostly diagnostic and qualitative, with limited coverage beyond BERT Base.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20-30 minutes. Focus on the graph formulation and the set-to-set IG definition first, because that is the main technical move. Then read the baseline ablations and normalized L2 comparison to understand the sensitivity of the method. The layer-wise visualization figures are useful for judging whether LIG would help analyze checkpoints, architecture variants, or training-stage differences in larger language models.

recommendation.zh: Transformer层内细粒度归因的新工具，做模型机制分析的研究员可精读§3的set-to-set IG推导，预训练工程侧无直接可落地动作
recommendation.en: Novel fine-grained intra-layer Transformer attribution tool; mechanism researchers can read §3's set-to-set IG derivation closely, no directly actionable insights for pretraining engineering

paper.title: Spectral Query-Key Product Weight Steering for Training-Free VLM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often generate fluent but visually unsupported descriptions, especially by mentioning objects absent from the image. We propose QK Product Steering, a data-free, training-free, and zero-inference-cost weight edit for reducing object hallucination. The method directly edits the per-head query-key product, the operator that produces pre-softmax attention logits, by suppressing a small number of dominant singular modes in selected middle layers. The edited product is t

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型(VLM)常生成图像中不存在的物体，产生物体幻觉，现有缓解方法多需要训练或额外推理成本。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无数据、无训练、零额外推理成本的权重编辑方法缓解VLM物体幻觉，兼容分组查询注意力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出QK Product Steering：在中间层注意力头中抑制QK乘积的少量主导奇异模，通过闭式更新仅修改query权重、固定key权重，实现训练无感的权重编辑；还分解QK乘积为对称/反对称分量区分内容相似与方向注意力模式。
summary.experiments: 在3个基于GQA的VLM上，CHAIR_s指标平均相对降低4.0%，随机模控制组效果可忽略，基本不损失通用生成能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models (VLMs) frequently hallucinate objects not present in images; existing mitigation methods usually require training or add inference overhead.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: data-free, training-free, zero-inference-cost weight edit to reduce VLM object hallucination, compatible with grouped-query attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: QK Product Steering suppresses a small number of dominant singular modes of the QK product in selected middle layers; applies closed-form query-only weight update while keeping shared keys fixed; further decomposes QK product into symmetric/antisymmetric components to separate content-similarity and directional attention patterns.
summary_en.experiments: Across 3 GQA-based VLMs, achieves average 4.0% relative CHAIR_s reduction; random-mode controls show negligible effect, with minimal loss of general generation capability.

recommendation.zh: 注意力QK谱分析+闭式权重编辑的思路干净，可迁移到纯LLM的幻觉/事实性修正，看奇异值分解部分即可。
recommendation.en: Clean approach of QK spectral analysis + closed-form weight editing transfers to hallucination / factuality correction in pure LLMs; read the SVD decomposition part only.

paper.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framew

summary.core_problem: 解决长文档 RAG 中检索粒度、上下文连贯性和索引/检索成本之间的权衡问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG 系统方法改进。它不是基座预训练工作，但对长上下文外部记忆、分层检索和无 LLM 索引的工程设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SproutRAG：用句间 attention 构建二叉 chunking tree，把句级片段组织成逐步变大的语义单元；检索时可在多粒度节点上搜索，不依赖额外 LLM 调用，也不通过摘要压缩文档。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集、模型规模和数值结果。实验应与 LLM-guided chunking、固定窗口扩展、层次摘要和普通 dense retrieval 等方法比较，重点看准确率、召回、上下文长度和索引/查询成本。
summary.authors_note: University of British Columbia 与 ServiceNow Research。Peter West 是长文本生成、评测和 NLP 系统方向较活跃的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the trade-off between retrieval granularity, contextual coherence, and cost in long-document RAG.
summary_en.importance: This is a RAG systems contribution rather than a pretraining paper. It is still relevant as a design point for hierarchical external memory and non-LLM indexing.
summary_en.technical_approach: SproutRAG builds a binary chunking tree from sentence-level chunks using learned inter-sentence attention. Retrieval can operate over multiple granularities without extra LLM calls or lossy summarization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, model sizes, or numerical gains. The relevant comparisons are against LLM-guided chunking, fixed context expansion, hierarchical summarization, and standard dense retrieval.
summary_en.authors_note: University of British Columbia and ServiceNow Research. Peter West is known for work around long-form generation, evaluation, and NLP systems.

recommendation.zh: 看树构建和检索策略即可；对预训练没直接动作，但可借鉴到长上下文记忆组织。
recommendation.en: Skim the tree construction and retrieval policy; it does not change pretraining, but it is a useful memory-organization pattern.

paper.title: Layer-Resolved Optimal Transport for Hallucination Detection in NMT and Abstractive Summarization
paper.abstract: Optimal transport (OT) has been shown to detect hallucinations in neural machine translation (NMT) by measuring the geometric distance between cross-attention distributions and a reference distribution, without any supervision. We extend this analysis to all six decoder layers of the Fairseq DE-EN model ($N=3{,}414$), showing that Wass-to-Unif and Wass-to-Data are complementary detectors specialised across hallucination types, that detection is concentrated in layers L1--L4 with L5 anti-predicti

summary.core_problem: 检验基于 cross-attention 分布几何距离的无监督 OT 信号，能否检测 NMT 和摘要中的幻觉，并分析该信号在不同 decoder layer 的位置。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和无监督检测方法扩展。论文把此前用于 NMT 幻觉检测的 optimal transport attention geometry 扩展到逐层分析，并测试其向摘要事实性检测的迁移。对理解 attention-hallucination 关系有参考，但模型和任务较传统。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Wasserstein 距离度量 cross-attention 分布与参考分布之间的几何差异，包括 Wass-to-Unif 和 Wass-to-Data 两类无监督检测器。作者对 Fairseq DE-EN 模型的六个 decoder layer 分层分析，并观察生成早期 attention 探索阶段是否存在；随后将同类 OT 信号迁移到 AggreFact 摘要事实性检测。
summary.experiments: NMT 部分使用 Fairseq DE-EN 模型，样本数 N=3,414。结果显示检测信号集中在 L1-L4，L5 对细微幻觉类型反而 anti-predictive；幻觉译文从第一个 decoding step 起缺少正确译文中的 exploratory attention phase。摘要部分在 AggreFact N=1,116 上评估，CNN/XSum balanced accuracy 为 57.2%/57.6%，高于随机但低于 supervised MiniCheck-Flan-T5-L 的 69.9%/74.3%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether unsupervised optimal-transport signals over cross-attention distributions can detect hallucinations in NMT and abstractive summarization, and where those signals appear across decoder layers.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis and unsupervised detection extension. It generalizes prior OT-based hallucination detection in NMT to layer-resolved analysis and tests transfer to summarization faithfulness. It is informative for attention-hallucination studies, though the models and tasks are relatively traditional.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method measures Wasserstein distances between cross-attention distributions and reference distributions, using Wass-to-Unif and Wass-to-Data as complementary unsupervised detectors. The authors analyze all six decoder layers of a Fairseq DE-EN model and inspect early decoding attention behavior, then transfer the same geometric signal to AggreFact summarization faithfulness detection.
summary_en.experiments: For NMT, the study uses a Fairseq DE-EN model with N=3,414 examples. Detection is concentrated in L1-L4, while L5 is anti-predictive for subtler hallucination types; hallucinated translations lack the exploratory attention phase seen in correct translations from the first decoding step. On AggreFact with N=1,116, the unsupervised detector reaches 57.2%/57.6% balanced accuracy on CNN/XSum, above chance but below supervised MiniCheck-Flan-T5-L at 69.9%/74.3%.

recommendation.zh: 看 layer-wise 结果即可；它提醒 attention 几何有信号但跨任务迁移弱，别把它当通用幻觉检测器。
recommendation.en: Read the layer-wise findings only; attention geometry carries signal, but the weak transfer argues against treating it as a general hallucination detector.

paper.title: The Structural Attention Tax: How Retrieval Format Hijacks In-Context Learning Independent of Content
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems inject external knowledge to improve LLM outputs, yet the format of injected content -- distinct from its semantic relevance -- can independently distort the model's attention distribution.
