We identify and formalise a phenomenon we term the structural attention tax: knowledge graph (KG) triples, due to their relational delimiters and repeated slot patterns, capture 2-3x more attention per token than semantically equivalent natural-language text ($\hat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“检索到什么”，而是“检索结果以什么格式进入上下文”。作者要解决的核心问题是：在 RAG 或 augmented ICL 中，结构化知识片段，尤其是 KG triples，会不会仅仅因为分隔符、槽位重复、关系词模板这些表面结构，就系统性地吸走注意力，从而挤压 demonstrations 和任务相关上下文的注意力预算。论文把这个现象定义为 structural attention tax，并试图把“格式偏置”和“语义价值”拆开分析：前者决定注意力被转移多少，后者决定这种转移究竟帮忙还是添乱。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它提醒人们 transformer 的上下文竞争不只受语义驱动，还受 token 级结构先验影响；这对 prompt 设计、RAG 接口、训练时数据格式混合都有直接意义。第二，它把 retrieval/source quality 与 prompt formatting 分成两条正交轴：语义轴决定检索内容是否有用，结构轴决定这些内容会不会不成比例地占据模型计算资源。这个区分对做长上下文预训练、合成数据模板设计、跨模态离散 token 接口的人都很有参考价值。不过量级上，这更像一个机制分析与接口设计提醒，而不是会直接改写基座训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者建立了一个 attention decomposition 框架。给定 prompt x=[I;D;K;q]，其中 I 是 instruction，D 是 demonstrations，K 是外部知识，q 是 query。作者把 query token 对知识区 K 的注意力分配写成语义项和结构项的组合，其中结构项由 λ·σ(K) 表示。σ(K) 是 structural intensity，来自三类可观测模式：结构分隔符密度、关系/槽位 token 的出现频率、以及局部重复模式。λ 则被视为模型内生的结构敏感系数，依赖层和头。这个分解的关键不是精确恢复真实注意力生成机制，而是提供一个可检验的工作假设：即使语义内容相同，只要格式更“结构化”，也会获得更高 attention mass。

实验设计围绕“格式-内容解耦”展开。作者构造七种条件，把相同语义内容分别写成自然语言、相关 triples、无关 triples、噪声 triples 等形式，比较它们对 demonstrations 区域 attention 的压缩效应。论文还提出一个 compression bound，用来说明在总 attention 归一化约束下，K 区域结构强度升高会怎样压缩 D 区域的可用注意力。

缓解方法部分给了五类策略，核心思路都是削弱 λ·σ(K)。其中真正做了实验的主要有两类。S3 format flattening：把 triples 改写成更接近自然语言或弱结构化文本，降低 delimiter 和 slot pattern 的显著性。S1 structural dispersal：把高度规则的结构打散，减少局部重复和模板集中度。另有 logit suppression、训练期正则等方案主要停留在理论或算法草图层面。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两个开源模型家族：Mistral-7B 和 LLaMA-3-8B；任务是三类 QA。最核心的结果有四点。

第一，KG triples 的 attention capture 明显高于中性自然语言。文中给出的代表性数字是，KG 区域的归一化结构强度估计约为 0.70，而 neutral text 约为 0.25；对应地，triples 每 token 吸收的注意力大约是自然语言的 2 到 3 倍。

第二，这种 attention capture 与语义是否相关关系不大。相关 triples、无关 triples、甚至噪声 triples 的 attention pattern 接近，说明模型先被格式吸引，再谈内容是否有用。这是全文最关键的证据，因为它支撑了“结构税独立于语义价值”的主张。

第三，demonstration attention 会被明显压缩，文中报告最高可达 42%。这说明问题不只是局部 token 被多看几眼，而是 prompt 内部的竞争格局被改写，进而影响 ICL 行为。

第四，在 source selection 上，任务匹配的 BM25 retrieval 相比不匹配的 ConceptNet retrieval，在 HotpotQA 上有超过 30 个百分点的优势，而更复杂的 gating 带来的收益不超过 2 个百分点。作者据此强调，先选对知识源，再谈精细 gating；语义对齐的重要性远大于在错误知识源上做复杂控制。

缓解实验里，S3 format flattening 得到较稳定支持：既改善准确率，也在 attention-level 分析中降低了结构区的吸附效应。S1 structural dispersal 结果较混合，存在模型依赖，说明“打散结构”未必总能转化为更好的任务表现，可能因为它同时损伤了可解析性或局部可读性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先抓三处。

第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。这里把问题讲得最清楚：attention budget 是固定的，结构化片段会竞争性地挤压 demonstrations。只要接受这个设定，后面的实验就容易理解。

第二，看 Section 3 的分解公式和 Proposition 1。这里不必过度纠结形式化是否严格到可作为理论定理使用，重点是理解作者如何把“结构强度”定义成可测量量，以及为什么它能导出 compression 预测。

第三，看 Section 5 的七条件实验和 attention 可视化。阅读时要特别留意“相关 triples 与噪声 triples attention 类似”这一证据，因为它决定这篇工作的说服力。再看 Section 5.3 的 source-alignment 结果，理解作者为何把 source quality 放在 gating 之前。

如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够把主张、证据和局限读明白。Appendix 里关于 S3 的补充实验值得扫一眼；S1 可以略读。阅读时也要保留一点怀疑：attention 是否能稳定代表功能性依赖、σ(K) 的定义是否对不同 tokenizer 和不同模型稳健、以及 retrieval unit 不一致会不会放大 source-selection 结论，这些都是论文自己也承认的边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about what to retrieve, but about how retrieved content is formatted inside the prompt. The core question is whether structured knowledge snippets, especially KG triples, can attract attention simply because of delimiters, slot regularity, and repeated relational patterns, even when their semantic value is unchanged. The authors call this effect the structural attention tax: a format-driven over-allocation of attention to structurally salient regions, which reduces the attention available to demonstrations and other task-critical context.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented readers is mostly conceptual and mechanistic. First, it argues that context competition in transformers is shaped not only by semantics but also by token-level structural priors. That matters for prompt interfaces, RAG design, synthetic data templating, and any training setup that mixes heterogeneous formats. Second, it separates two axes that are often conflated: semantic usefulness of retrieved content versus structural propensity to capture attention. The former determines whether the extra context helps; the latter determines how much compute budget it consumes inside the prompt. This is a useful lens for long-context training, retrieval formatting, and multimodal token interface design, though it is more of an analysis paper than a direct pretraining recipe change.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical contribution is an attention decomposition framework for augmented in-context learning. The prompt is written as x=[I;D;K;q], where I is instruction, D demonstrations, K injected knowledge, and q the query. Attention from query tokens to K is decomposed into a semantic component and a structural component. The structural term is written as λ·σ(K), where σ(K) measures structural intensity and λ is a model-intrinsic sensitivity coefficient that can vary by layer and head.

σ(K) is defined from observable prompt statistics: density of structural delimiters, frequency of relation/slot markers, and repetitiveness of local token patterns. The point is not to claim an exact generative theory of attention, but to provide a testable abstraction: even when semantic content is held fixed, more structured formatting should capture more attention.

The empirical design is built around format-content decoupling. The authors compare semantically equivalent content rendered in different forms, including natural-language passages, relevant triples, irrelevant triples, and noise triples. They also derive a compression-style bound showing that, under normalized attention, increased structural intensity in K must reduce the attention available to D.

The mitigation section proposes five structure-aware strategies, all aimed at reducing λ·σ(K). Two are tested empirically. S3, format flattening, rewrites triples into weaker or more natural language-like forms to reduce delimiter and slot salience. S1, structural dispersal, breaks up highly regular local patterns to reduce repetitive structural cues. Other ideas, such as logit suppression and training-time regularization, are presented more as mathematically motivated directions than fully validated methods.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use two model families, Mistral-7B and LLaMA-3-8B, across three QA tasks. Four results matter most.

First, KG triples capture substantially more attention than neutral natural-language text. The paper reports representative structural intensity estimates around 0.70 for KG-formatted content versus about 0.25 for neutral text, and triples absorb roughly 2x to 3x more attention per token.

Second, this attention capture is largely insensitive to semantic relevance. Relevant triples, irrelevant triples, and even noise triples show very similar attention patterns. That is the central empirical support for the paper’s claim: the tax is driven by format before usefulness is even considered.

Third, demonstration attention is compressed by as much as 42% in some settings. So the effect is not a small local preference; it changes the competitive allocation of context budget inside the prompt and can alter ICL behavior.

Fourth, source alignment dominates gating sophistication. On HotpotQA, task-matched BM25 retrieval outperforms mismatched ConceptNet retrieval by more than 30 percentage points, while more elaborate gating contributes no more than about 2 points. The intended message is that choosing the right knowledge source matters far more than adding control logic on top of a poorly matched source.

For mitigation, S3 format flattening is the strongest result: it improves accuracy and reduces attention concentration on structured regions. S1 structural dispersal is mixed and model-dependent, suggesting that reducing structural regularity does not automatically translate into better task performance, possibly because it also harms readability or local parseability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts.

Start with the introduction and Figure 1. They state the main claim clearly: prompt regions compete for a fixed attention budget, and structured snippets can crowd out demonstrations.

Then read Section 3 and the proposition around the compression argument. The exact formalism is less important than understanding how the authors operationalize structural intensity and why it predicts attention diversion.

Finally, read the seven-condition experiments in Section 5, especially the comparison between relevant triples and noise triples. If those two attract similar attention, the format-driven claim becomes much more convincing. Section 5.3 is also worth reading because it reframes the practical takeaway: source quality matters more than sophisticated gating.

A 30 to 40 minute pass is enough to extract the main idea, evidence, and limitations. The appendix for S3 is worth a quick look. Keep some skepticism while reading: attention is not always a faithful proxy for functional dependence, the σ(K) definition may be tokenizer- and model-sensitive, and the source-alignment result is partly confounded by retrieval-unit differences, which the paper itself acknowledges.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新方法，但它在提醒一个常被忽略的 confound：你以为在测检索质量，实际在测格式诱导的注意力税；先看公式分解和那组 0.70 vs 0.25 的结果。
recommendation.en: Not a new method, but it isolates a confound people often miss: you think you are measuring retrieval quality, but you may be measuring format-induced attention tax; read the decomposition and the 0.70 vs 0.25 result first.

paper.title: The Interlocutor Effect: Why LLMs Leak More Personal Data to Agents Than Humans
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) alter their privacy behavior based on the perceived identity of their interlocutor. While safety mechanisms typically prevent LLMs from releasing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) to human users, these models tend to reveal more sensitive data when addressing another AI agent.   We refer to this as the \textbf{Interlocutor Effect}. Through an ablation study, we find evidence that the technical nature of the recipient contributes to this effect, thereby dimini

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 LLM 是否会因为“对话对象被描述为 AI agent 而不是人类”而更容易泄露个人敏感信息。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法论文，但对 agent 化部署下的对齐数据覆盖有启发。现有 RLHF 和 Constitutional AI 数据主要是人机对话，模型可能把隐私约束绑定到“面向人类回答”的场景；当输出被 framing 成发给另一个 agent 或技术系统时，隐私行为会改变。这个现象提示，安全训练和评测不能只覆盖 human-facing chat，还应覆盖 agent-to-agent、tool message、structured protocol 等通信形态。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用一个 2×2 factorial design 分离 interlocutor identity 和 communication format 两个变量：Human vs. Agent，Text vs. A2A JSON。四个条件共享同样的数据治理 policy 和 PII vault，只改变接收者 framing 和输出格式。数据包含 222 个合成场景，覆盖医疗、金融、法律、企业 HR 等四类敏感域，并混合 Medium 和 Hard 难度。评估模型包括 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Llama 3.3 70B、Mistral Large。泄露检测采用三层 pipeline：canary matching、受 vault 约束的 regex 抽取、以及 Qwen-2.5-7B 作为 judge 做语义级判断。论文还加入 Technical Human 条件，用来区分“agent 身份”与“技术接收者 framing”的影响，并提出 Attention Suppression Hypothesis：与隐私安全相关的 attention heads 在 agent-directed prompts 中可能更不活跃。
summary.experiments: 主实验共 3,464 个 prompt-response pairs，temperature 为 0.7；Mistral Large 在 200 个场景子集上评估。关键结果是 interlocutor 和 format 有明显交互：在 plain text 中，agent framing 相比 human framing 使 PII 泄露率增加 11.5 个百分点；在 JSON 格式中，这个差异几乎消失，只剩 0.6 个百分点。JSON 对 human-directed prompts 几乎没有影响，变化为 -0.7 个百分点；但对 agent-directed prompts 有明显缓解，泄露率下降 11.7 个百分点。GPT-4o 的三条件 ablation 显示技术接收者 framing 有统计证据支持，p=0.030；agent identity 作为具体形态也显著，p=0.006，rank-biserial correlation r=0.40。Llama 3.3 70B 上对应结果不显著，p=0.558，说明现象的跨模型泛化仍需谨慎判断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。优先看 Interlocutor Effect 的定义、2×2 实验设计、Table I 的 prompt 控制变量、Table II 的交互结果，以及 Technical Human ablation。mechanistic interpretability 部分可快速浏览，重点看它是否只是相关性观察，还是做了 head-level intervention。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是实验设计：它展示了如何把 protocol artifact、format artifact 和 social framing 分开评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs leak more personal data when the recipient is framed as another AI agent rather than a human.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to alignment coverage in agentic systems. Current RLHF and constitutional training data are heavily human-facing. The model may therefore associate privacy caution with human-directed conversation, while treating agent-to-agent or technical messages as a context where information transfer should be maximized. The practical implication is that safety training and evaluation should include tool messages, inter-agent protocols, and structured machine-directed outputs, not only normal chat.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses a controlled 2×2 factorial design that crosses interlocutor identity with communication format: Human vs. Agent and Text vs. A2A JSON. The four conditions share the same data-governance policy and PII vault; only recipient framing and output format are changed. The benchmark contains 222 synthetic scenarios across healthcare, finance, legal, and corporate domains, with Medium and Hard difficulty settings. The evaluated models include GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama 3.3 70B, and Mistral Large. Leakage is detected with a three-stage pipeline: canary matching, vault-constrained regex extraction, and semantic judging with Qwen-2.5-7B. A separate Technical Human ablation tests whether the effect is specific to agent identity or more generally caused by technical-recipient framing. The paper also proposes an Attention Suppression Hypothesis, suggesting that privacy-related attention heads may become less active under agent-directed prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The main benchmark contains 3,464 prompt-response pairs at temperature 0.7, with Mistral Large evaluated on a 200-scenario subset. The key finding is an interaction between interlocutor identity and output format. In plain text, agent framing increases PII leakage by 11.5 percentage points relative to human framing. In JSON, the gap is almost gone, at 0.6 points. JSON formatting has little effect for human-directed prompts, changing leakage by -0.7 points, but strongly mitigates leakage under agent framing, reducing it by 11.7 points. In the GPT-4o ablation, technical-recipient framing is supported statistically with p=0.030, and agent identity as a concrete instantiation is also significant with p=0.006 and rank-biserial correlation r=0.40. The corresponding result on Llama 3.3 70B is not significant, p=0.558, so the generality across model families remains uncertain.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 15–20 minutes. Focus on the definition of the Interlocutor Effect, the 2×2 design, Table I for prompt controls, Table II for the interaction between identity and format, and the Technical Human ablation. The mechanistic section is worth a quick pass, mainly to check whether it reports correlational head-activity differences or performs stronger interventions. For researchers working on foundation-model training, the most useful part is the evaluation design: it cleanly separates protocol artifacts, formatting effects, and social framing.

recommendation.zh: 对齐机制的反常识漏洞发现，泄露幅度数据可靠，重点看§3场景构造方法与§4.2注意力头分析，可用于内部对齐鲁棒性ablation。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive vulnerability finding for alignment mechanisms with reliable leakage magnitude data; focus on §3 scenario construction and §4.2 attention head analysis, useful for internal alignment robustness ablation.

paper.title: Contribution Weights: A Geometrical Analysis of Self-Attention Transformers
paper.abstract: Analyzing attention weights has become a standard approach for interpreting the information flow of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, this approach has significant limitations as it neglects the geometric properties of the value vectors being aggregated. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Contribution Weights}, a projection-based metric that quantifies a token's influence by accounting for it's attention weight, value magnitude, and directional alignment with the layer output. We demon

summary.core_problem: 重新评估 Transformer 自注意力中的“token 重要性”如何度量，指出只看 attention weight 会忽略 value 向量的大小和方向。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和解释指标改进。它把注意力解释从标量权重推进到几何投影，直接触及 LLM 中信息聚合、attention sink 和 token 贡献归因这些基础问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Contribution Weights：用投影式度量同时考虑 attention weight、value vector magnitude，以及 value 与 layer output 的方向对齐程度。相比 raw attention，它试图衡量某个 token 对层输出的实际几何贡献，而不是仅衡量被 attend 的概率质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在不同 decoder-only 模型、任务和数据集上，Contribution Weights 在识别语义关键 token 方面稳定优于基于 attention 的指标。还用该指标分析 attention sinks，发现 sink token 不只是吸收多余注意力，还可能通过几何关系主动压制信息。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits how token importance should be measured in Transformer self-attention, arguing that raw attention weights ignore the magnitude and direction of value vectors.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It moves attention interpretation from scalar attention probabilities to a geometric account of actual contribution, which is directly relevant to information flow, attention sinks, and attribution in LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Contribution Weights, a projection-based metric that combines attention weight, value-vector magnitude, and directional alignment with the layer output. The goal is to estimate the geometric contribution of a token to the layer output rather than only measuring how much probability mass attends to it.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent gains over attention-based metrics for identifying semantically critical tokens across decoder-only models, tasks, and datasets. The metric is also used to analyze attention sinks, suggesting they can actively suppress information rather than merely absorb excess attention. Concrete model sizes, datasets, and effect sizes are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和 sink 分析；它不会改变训练 recipe，但会让 attention 可解释性少犯一类常见错误。
recommendation.en: Skim the metric and sink analysis; it will not change a training recipe, but it reduces a common attribution mistake around attention.

paper.title: Multiscale POD of Transformer Attention Fields: Scale-Selective Analysis via Morlet Scalogram
paper.abstract: We introduce scale-selective Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) for transformer attention fields, inspired by the use of POD for extracting energetically dominant modes from turbulent flow ensembles. The Morlet continuous wavelet transform identifies dominant temporal scales in the attention lag structure across a document ensemble; POD then extracts the energetically dominant modes at each scale from the ensemble of attention fields. The resulting modes reveal layer-dependent scale organisat

summary.core_problem: 现有注意力场分析方法缺乏多尺度分解能力，无法量化不同层对不同长度依赖关系的建模偏好。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将流体力学领域的 Proper Orthogonal Decomposition（POD）与连续小波变换结合，用于Transformer注意力场的尺度选择性分析。
summary.technical_approach: 用Morlet连续小波变换识别注意力滞后结构中的主导时间尺度，再对每个尺度的注意力场集合做POD提取能量主导模式，定义谱集中度指标衡量各层注意力场复杂度，方法无需修改模型架构。
summary.experiments: 未明确具体模型参数量，在文档集合上验证了早期层侧重细尺度局部依赖、后期层转向粗尺度全局依赖的层级结构，所提指标可区分不同层的注意力复杂度，POD模式满足L2重建误差最优并附定理证明。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing attention field analysis methods lack multi-scale decomposition capability and cannot quantify layer-specific preferences for dependency lengths.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first to combine Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) from fluid dynamics with continuous wavelet transform for scale-selective analysis of Transformer attention fields.
summary_en.technical_approach: Morlet continuous wavelet transform identifies dominant temporal scales in attention lag structures; POD then extracts energetically dominant modes at each scale. A spectral concentration index is defined to measure attention field complexity per layer, with no architectural modifications required.
summary_en.experiments: No explicit model size is specified. Empirical validation on a document corpus confirms early layers emphasize fine-scale local dependencies while late layers shift to coarse-scale global dependencies. The proposed index differentiates layer complexity, and POD optimality is proven via Theorem 1.

recommendation.zh: 跨领域迁移的注意力分析思路新颖，但无直接可落地的预训练改进结论，仅做思路参考。
recommendation.en: This cross-disciplinary attention analysis offers a novel analytical lens but no actionable pretraining improvements, only for reference as a methodological idea.

paper.title: Pattern Selectivity is Not Task-Causal Structure: A Cross-Architecture Mechanistic Study of Composed-Task Circuits in 1B-Class Language Models
paper.abstract: We test whether a single screen-and-ablate recipe -- identify attention-head circuits by task-pattern selectivity, then verify by causal ablation against a matched-random null -- produces consistent mechanistic claims across model families. The recipe ports across pipelines; the specific circuit it identifies does not. Across four composed tasks (indirect-object identification, greater-than, successor sequences, variable binding) and three 1B-class language models from distinct training pipeline

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“某个任务有没有可解释电路”，而是更尖锐的问题：一套在 GPT-2 / IOI 上被广泛接受的 mechanistic interpretability 配方——先用注意力模式选择头，再做因果消融——换到不同训练语料、不同架构、但能力相近的 1B 级模型上，是否还能得到稳定、可迁移的机制结论。作者把问题放在 composed tasks 上检验，包括 IOI、greater-than、successor sequences 和 variable binding。全文给出的答案是否定的：同一任务在不同模型里，能通过因果验证的“主因果屏幕”并不一致；更强的说法是，在 4×3 的 12 个 task-model 单元里，没有两个单元在可比效应量下共享同一个 primary causal screen。这直接挑战了“pattern selectivity≈task-causal structure”的默认前提。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于它给机制分析和跨模型归纳划了边界。很多人会把某个模型里发现的 head class，当成任务实现的普遍结构，再进一步拿它解释训练动态、数据影响或架构差异。这里的结果提醒你：在 1B 级、自然语料预训练模型上，任务可解并不意味着机制同构；同样的行为能力可以由不同的中间电路实现。对基座研究员，这意味着两点。第一，拿 mechanistic finding 去反推 pretrain recipe 时要更谨慎，尤其不能把单模型发现直接上升为“任务需要这种电路”。第二，架构和数据分布确实会改变模型选择的计算路径，MoE 甚至可能系统性偏向某类基础电路。贡献量级上，它更像一篇方法学纠偏和经验边界测绘的论文，而不是给出统一理论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者沿用前作的 screen-and-ablate recipe，但把它做成了严格对齐的跨模型实验。第一步是 spectral signal：对每个 attention head 计算基于奇异值谱的 participation ratio 积分，筛出长期进行内容相关计算、而不是纯 sink 行为的头。第二步是 task-pattern screen：针对每个任务定义候选注意力模式，再按 selectivity 阈值过滤出小规模候选电路。以 IOI 为例，作者不是只看 name-mover，而是并列测试 prev-token、induction、name-mover、S-Inhibition 四类屏幕；greater-than、successor、variable binding 也各自定义了与任务结构对应的模式。第三步是 causal verification：对候选头做 group mean-ablation，并和同层、同数量、无重叠的 matched-random 头做对照，报告 top-1 和 logit-diff 的下降。

全文里真正有信息量的部分有三点。其一，作者没有把“被选中”直接当成机制，而是引入五分类 taxonomy：primary cause、secondary cause、correlate、interferer、null。也就是说，同样高 selectivity 的头，可能是支持任务、只是伴随相关、甚至会干扰任务；只有结合因果消融才能区分。其二，作者专门讨论了 matched-random control 的失效边界：如果候选头集中在 L0-L1，same-layer 随机对照方差会很大，因为早层本来就承载输入嵌入和通用内容路由，这时 null floor 偏弱，不能过度解读。其三，作者提出一个可证伪的结构假设：OLMoE 1B-7B 在 4 个任务里有 3 个任务表现出 prev-token primacy，即 composed-task 电路建立在更基础的 prev-token positional substrate 上，而不是直接落在任务语义最贴切的 pattern 上。这个假设把“架构差异”具体化成了 MoE 可能偏好的计算基底。
summary.experiments:
实验面板是三种 1B 级模型：Pythia 1B（Pile，dense）、OLMo 1B（DCLM，dense）、OLMoE 1B-7B（DCLM，64 experts，top-8，1B active params）。作者先说明为什么选这个规模：GPT-2 small 在 IOI 上并不能稳定解题，top-1 只有 13%，IO-vs-subject 57%；而 1B active 级别才进入“任务可靠可解”的区间，因此更适合比较机制而不是比较是否会做。

关键结果有三层。第一，IOI 上三模型的 primary screen 已经分裂：Pythia 是 prev-token-primary，OLMo 是 S-Inhibition-primary，OLMoE 是 name-mover-primary。也就是说，连最经典、最容易让人期待复现 canonical circuit 的任务，都没有出现跨模型一致的主因果结构。第二，把范围扩到另外三个 composed tasks 后，12 个单元里没有两个在可比效应量下共享同一 primary causal screen。这个结论比“有差异”更强，它说明差异不是零星噪声，而是系统性的非一致。第三，OLMoE 呈现出明显的 prev-token-primacy pattern：在 greater-than、successor、variable binding 三个任务上，主因果屏幕都落在 prev-token，而不是任务直觉上更专门的模式；只有 IOI 例外，作者解释为 IOI 的最终位置本身就直接探测 name copying。

消融层面，作者使用每个 cell 十个 seed 的 matched-random null 来估计 specificity differential，这比单次随机对照更稳，也让“候选头是否真的比同层随机头更 task-specific”有了不确定性范围。另一个值得注意的实验观察是，group ablation 有时会把 supporter 和 interferer 混在一起，因此作者强调 individual-head ablation 是必要诊断，而不是可有可无的补充。论文摘要截断了部分具体数值，现有全文片段没有完整表格，但从叙述可以确认：作者更看重相对效应、对照差值和分类归因，而不是单一绝对 drop。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着“方法边界”去读，不适合当成某个任务电路图谱来背。先看 Introduction，把三个操作性问题和主要结论读清楚，尤其是 12 个 cell 无重复 primary screen 这一句。然后看 Methodology Recap，重点理解 PR-integral 在这里不是 task-specific detector，只是 specialization indicator；真正把一般性专门化变成任务相关发现的是 pattern screen 加 causal verification。接着看各任务的 screen 定义，尤其 IOI 四类屏幕为什么都要并列测，而不是预设 canonical head class。实验部分优先看每个 task-model cell 的 group ablation 对 matched-random 的差值，以及 taxonomy 判定标准，弄清 primary / secondary / correlate / interferer / null 是怎么落下来的。最后看作者对 OLMoE prev-token-primacy 的讨论和预测，这部分最接近可继续验证的研究问题。

如果时间有限，建议 40–60 分钟泛读：Introduction、方法总览、主结果图表、taxonomy 和 OLMoE 假设。若要精读，值得深挖两点：一是早层 matched-random control 为什么会失真，这关系到很多 interpretability 实验的统计地板；二是“同能力、异机制”到底来自数据、架构还是优化路径，论文没有完全分解，但给了很好的实验框架。
summary.authors_note: 从正文可确认这是 Xu 在 2026 年三篇系列工作的第 3 篇，前两篇分别讨论 screen-and-ablate 配方本身，以及这些电路在预训练中的形成时间线。当前片段未给出完整作者列表与机构信息，无法可靠补全。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a stricter question than whether a task admits an interpretable circuit. It tests whether a widely used recipe in mechanistic interpretability—pattern-based head screening followed by causal ablation—yields stable mechanistic claims across model families when the task is held fixed. The setting is composed tasks rather than simple capability probes: indirect object identification, greater-than, successor sequences, and variable binding. The answer is negative. The recipe transfers as a procedure, but the circuit it identifies does not. Across a 4-task × 3-model panel of 1B-class LMs, no two task-model cells share the same primary causal screen at comparable effect size. That directly weakens the common move from pattern selectivity to task-causal structure.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is methodological and diagnostic. Mechanistic findings are often used to reason backward about data, architecture, or training dynamics. This paper shows that such inferences are fragile if they rely on a single model and a single canonical circuit decomposition. At 1B scale, models with similar task competence can implement the same composed task through different causal head sets. For foundation-model work, that means two things. First, one should be careful when using interpretability results to justify claims about what pretraining must have learned. Second, architecture and corpus choices can alter the computational substrate selected during training, with MoE showing a potentially systematic bias. The contribution is not a new training recipe; it is a careful map of where cross-model mechanistic generalization breaks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper applies a unified screen-and-ablate pipeline, inherited from earlier work, to a matched cross-model panel. Step 1 is a spectral signal: for each attention head, the authors compute a participation-ratio integral over the singular value spectrum of attention outputs across checkpoints. This is meant to surface heads engaged in sustained content-dependent computation rather than generic sink behavior. Step 2 is task-pattern screening: for each task, they define candidate attention patterns and keep heads whose selectivity exceeds fixed thresholds. For IOI, they explicitly test four candidate screens—prev-token, induction, name-mover, and S-Inhibition—rather than assuming the canonical IOI decomposition will transfer. Step 3 is causal verification: they group-ablate the selected heads via mean ablation and compare the drop in top-1 and logit-diff against matched-random controls drawn from the same layers with equal head count and no overlap.

Three methodological refinements matter. First, the paper does not equate selection with mechanism. It introduces a five-way taxonomy: primary cause, secondary cause, correlate, interferer, and null. A head class can be highly selective yet only correlated, or even harmful, unless causal tests confirm its role. Second, the matched-random control is treated carefully. When selected heads concentrate in very early layers, same-layer random controls have high variance and a weak null floor because L0-L1 already carry broad embedding and routing functions. The paper explicitly marks where that bound is informative and where it is not. Third, the authors formulate a falsifiable structural hypothesis from the observed MoE behavior: OLMoE at 1B active scale may build composed-task circuits on top of a foundational prev-token positional substrate, except when the task directly probes another pattern such as final-position name copying in IOI.
summary_en.experiments:
The model panel contains Pythia 1B trained on the Pile, OLMo 1B trained on DCLM, and OLMoE 1B-7B trained on DCLM with 64 experts and top-8 routing, all compared at roughly 1B active parameters. The scale choice is motivated in the paper: GPT-2 small does not reliably solve IOI, reaching only 13% top-1 and 57% IO-vs-subject, so the authors move to the smallest natural-text models where the task is actually solved.

The main empirical findings are strong. On IOI alone, the primary causal screen already differs by model: prev-token for Pythia, S-Inhibition for OLMo, and name-mover for OLMoE. Extending to greater-than, successor, and variable binding makes the pattern sharper: across all 12 task-model cells, there is no repeated primary causal screen at comparable effect size. This is stronger than saying there is some variation; it suggests systematic non-isomorphism in implementation. A second notable result is the OLMoE prev-token-primacy pattern. On three of the four tasks—greater-than, successor, and variable binding—the primary causal screen in OLMoE is prev-token rather than the task-specific pattern one might expect from the task structure. IOI is the exception, which the authors argue is consistent with IOI directly probing final-position name copying.

The control design is also worth noting. Each cell uses a matched-random null sampled across ten seeds, allowing the authors to report specificity differentials with uncertainty rather than relying on one random comparison. The paper also emphasizes that group ablation can mix supportive and interfering heads, so individual-head ablations are needed to disambiguate supporters from interferers. The excerpt provided does not include the full result tables, so many exact drop values are not visible here, but the paper’s empirical logic is centered on relative causal effect against matched-random baselines and on the taxonomy assignment, not on a single absolute metric.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a paper about the limits of mechanistic portability, not as a catalog of task circuits. Start with the Introduction and the three operational questions. The sentence to keep in mind is that no two of the 12 cells share the same primary causal screen at comparable effect size. Then read the methodology recap carefully. The key point is that the PR-integral is only a general specialization indicator; task specificity comes from the pattern screen plus causal verification. After that, inspect how each task’s candidate screens are defined, especially why IOI is tested with four competing screens instead of assuming the GPT-2-style decomposition. In the results, focus on the group-ablation deltas relative to matched-random controls and on how the five-category taxonomy is assigned. Finish with the discussion of OLMoE prev-token primacy and the predictions for other MoE models, since that is the most concrete forward-looking hypothesis.

For a skim, 40–60 minutes is enough for the introduction, method overview, main result figures, taxonomy section, and the MoE discussion. For a deeper read, two issues deserve extra attention: why early-layer matched-random controls become statistically weak, and how much of the observed mechanism divergence should be attributed to data, architecture, or optimization path. The paper does not fully disentangle those factors, but it sets up a useful framework for doing so.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper identifies itself as Paper 3 in a three-paper series by Xu from 2026. Paper 1 introduces the screen-and-ablate recipe, and Paper 2 studies the formation timeline of these circuits during pretraining. The provided text does not include a reliable full author list or institution metadata.

recommendation.zh: 跨架构机制研究的重要阴性结果——相同任务在不同模型中不共享因果通路，直接质疑跨模型通用电路的存在；实验设计干净（10种子+匹配零假设），值得细看Fig和结果分类学。
recommendation.en: Important negative result in cross-architecture mechanistic study — same task does not share causal circuits across different models, directly challenging universal cross-model circuits; clean design (10 seeds + matched null), worth examining figures and outcome taxonomy.

Unlike typical natural language (and software coding) tasks, LLM-based RTL code generation demands strict cycle accuracy with concurrency, where minor logical errors can render a circuit unusable or insecure. While prior work has explored hallucination mitigation via exte

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM生成RTL代码时易出现逻辑错误，多数方法忽略LLM内部注意力机制与RTL正确性的内在关联
summary.importance: 首次提出利用LLM内部正确性感知组件引导RTL生成的框架，属于方法创新+机制发现
summary.technical_approach: 提出CASS-RTL框架，首先识别与RTL正确性相关的注意力头，通过子空间引导技术 steer 模型生成功能正确的RTL代码
